summary: ArcelorMittal has partnered with the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games to produce key steel items including torches, cauldrons, and the Olympic and Paralympic logos. The company aims to demonstrate the low-carbon potential of steel in line with Paris 2024's environmental goals. This marks another instance of ArcelorMittal's involvement in major multi-sport events, having previously sponsored the London 2012 Olympics and the 2015 Pan American Games.

title: Tom Long to replace Blake Krueger as Wolverine Worldwide chairman
summary: Wolverine Worldwide, Inc. announced that its chairman and retired CEO, Blake Krueger, will retire from the board on May 4, 2023. Tom Long, the board’s lead independent director, will succeed Krueger as chairman. The company also appointed Stacia Andersen, Jodi Bricker, and DeMonty Price to its board of directors, effective March 14, 2023, while director David McCreight will resign on May 4, 2023.

title: Coca-Cola is inviting fans to create AI art with its iconic imagery
summary: Coca-Cola is launching a campaign that invites fans in 17 countries to create AI-generated art using its iconic imagery, facilitated by OpenAI's DALL-E and GPT systems. The best submissions will be displayed on billboards in New York and London, and top AI artists will be invited to a Creative Academy in Atlanta. This initiative marks a broader effort by Coca-Cola to explore generative AI and collaborate with artists in new ways.

title: Coca-Cola Femsa informe integrado 2022: Future-Ready
summary: Coca-Cola FEMSA released its 2022 Integrated Annual Report, "Future-Ready," detailing significant operational, financial, and non-financial achievements. The report highlights successes in portfolio expansion, omnichannel strategies, sustainability (ESG), and culture, alongside impressive financial growth including an 8.6% increase in sales volume and 16.4% in total revenues. The company also made substantial progress in sustainable financing and environmental initiatives, including significant investments in circular economy and renewable energy.

title: Coca-Cola voice campaign urges viewers to tell Alexa when they see Coke in movies and shows
summary: Coca-Cola has launched a voice campaign encouraging viewers to use Alexa to report sightings of Coke products in movies and TV shows. This initiative aims to leverage interactive technology to engage audiences and promote brand recognition within entertainment media.

title: Jack Daniel’s® and Coca-Cola® RTD Launches in Great Britain
summary: Jack Daniel's and Coca-Cola have officially launched their ready-to-drink (RTD) product in Great Britain, following its debut in Mexico in November 2022. This collaboration brings together Jack Daniel's Tennessee Whiskey and Coca-Cola in a convenient format, inspired by the popular bar call. A Coca-Cola Zero Sugar version will also be available, with plans for the product to expand to other global markets throughout 2023.

title: Ready to Drink Jack and Coke Launches
summary: Coca-Cola and Brown-Forman have officially launched their Ready-to-Drink (RTD) Jack Daniel's & Coca-Cola in the United States, following a successful debut in Mexico. This pre-mixed canned cocktail, marrying Jack Daniel's Tennessee Whiskey with Coca-Cola, will be available in 12-oz. cans (7% ABV), with a Zero Sugar version launching in May. The collaboration represents a major innovation for both brands, expanding into the growing flavored alcohol beverage market while emphasizing responsible marketing and consumption.

title: Sysco names Kenny Cheung CFO, promotes Neil Russell to new role
summary: Sysco Corp. has appointed Kenny Cheung as its new Chief Financial Officer, effective April 17, 2023. Neil Russell, who previously served as interim CFO, has been promoted to the newly created role of Chief Administrative Officer. Cheung joins Sysco from the Hertz Corp., where he held the position of executive vice president and chief financial officer.

title: Jack Daniel's and Coca-Cola® Ready-to-Drink Launches in the U.S.
summary: Jack Daniel's and Coca-Cola® have officially launched their ready-to-drink (RTD) cocktail, Jack Daniel's & Coca-Cola, in the United States. This pre-mixed beverage, inspired by the popular bar-call, combines Jack Daniel's Tennessee Whiskey with Coca-Cola and is available nationwide. A Zero-Sugar version will also be released, and both brands emphasize responsible consumption.

title: Kraft Heinz agrees to sell Russian baby food business
summary: Kraft Heinz has agreed to sell its Russian baby food business, including two factories and the "Umnitsa" and "Sami s usami" brands, to local drinks and snacks maker Chernogolovka. This sale is part of a trend where Russian firms acquire assets from Western companies exiting the market due to the Ukraine conflict, though Kraft Heinz noted the deal was initiated before the conflict began. The transaction, which is subject to regulatory approval, is estimated to be worth between 2.5 and 3 billion roubles, amid regulations requiring foreign sellers to donate a portion of the sale price to the Russian budget.

title: AMC Theatres and The Coca-Cola Company Celebrate 'Flavour' in Campaign Partnership
summary: AMC Theatres and The Coca-Cola Company have launched the 'Flavor Make It' campaign to attract Gen Z moviegoers. Developed by Barkley, the initiative offers a $5 combo deal with AMC popcorn and a Coca-Cola Freestyle drink, featuring three new exclusive custom flavors. The campaign includes a vibrant anthem video, social media promotion with Gen Z influencers, and a dedicated landing page for sharing custom flavor combinations.

title: Coca-Cola partners with Gigi Hadid on food-centric campaign
summary: Coca-Cola has launched a new global campaign titled "A Recipe for Magic," focusing on the theme of interpersonal connections formed over shared meals. Supermodel Gigi Hadid is headlining the campaign in several markets, supported by a network of 750 influencers and chefs to ensure local relevance. This initiative aligns with Coke's consistent marketing strategy emphasizing diversity and togetherness, building on research indicating the drink enhances social gatherings.

title: Topo Chico Plant Provides Free Water to its Monterrey Neighbors
summary: The Topo Chico plant in Monterrey, Mexico, has been providing free drinking water to its local community 24/7 for over a century. This initiative proved critical during a severe drought in 2022, highlighting the Coca-Cola system's commitment to water security. The company is also working with partners to rehabilitate wells and install rainwater harvesting systems in schools, fostering a culture of responsible water use.

title: iShares Global Consumer Staples ETF (KXI) Stock Price, Holdings, Dividend Yield
summary: This article provides an in-depth look at the iShares Global Consumer Staples ETF (KXI), detailing its stock price, holdings, dividend yield, and key statistics. It highlights top holdings such as Costco, Nestle, PepsiCo, and Philip Morris International, along with historical performance metrics and asset allocation. The report also includes information from its latest N-PORT filing, showing 95 total holdings with a portfolio value of $854.00 million.

title: Coca-Cola India invests in food delivery company Thrive
summary: Coca-Cola India is investing in Thrive, a Mumbai-based food delivery platform that aims to offer restaurants lower commission rates compared to market duopolies. This partnership will allow Thrive to expand its reach and enable consumers to order Coca-Cola beverages directly with their meals from partner restaurants, enhancing the online food delivery experience. The collaboration is expected to capitalize on the rapid growth of the Indian online food delivery market.

title: Coca-Cola Empowers Women in Foodservice Industry
summary: The Coca-Cola Company continues its over two-decade-long support for the Women's Foodservice Forum (WFF) to empower women in the foodservice industry. A delegation of 135 leaders from Coca-Cola North America attended the recent WFF Leadership Conference, aligning with the company's goal for 50% female leadership globally by 2030. The conference offered leadership development, networking, and inspiration, with notable participation from both women and male allies.

title: Coca-Cola beats expectations thanks to higher prices, innovations that appeals to Gen Z
summary: Coca-Cola significantly outperformed expectations in Q1 2023, driven by higher prices, revenue growth management, and successful Gen Z engagement through limited-time flavors and AI-powered marketing campaigns. Despite strong results, the company maintained its full-year guidance due to economic uncertainties regarding inflation and consumer spending. Coca-Cola also saw success in its expanded portfolio, particularly with premium dairy brand fairlife, while acknowledging the need to stabilize other brands like Body Armor.

title: Coca-Cola Investors Reject Proposal for Abortion Risk Report (1)
summary: Coca-Cola Co. investors rejected a proposal seeking a report on how state abortion restrictions impact the beverage company's business. The proposal, filed by As You Sow, aimed to detail potential workforce risks or costs and secured 13% of the preliminary vote. The article notes that despite potential political implications, the issue of abortion restrictions can affect business operations.

title: 30% of Dow Shareholders Urge Company to Study Future With Less Virgin Plastic
summary: A shareholder resolution filed with Dow Inc. by As You Sow, requesting the company report on the impact of reduced global demand for virgin plastic, received support from over 30% of shareholders. This proposal highlights the growing concern over single-use plastics and the need for companies like Dow, a major producer of plastic resins, to assess their reliance on these materials. The resolution also sought disclosure on the cost-effectiveness, efficiency, and environmental soundness of chemical recycling technologies Dow plans to use.

title: The Coca-Cola Company Elects Three Officers and Declares Regular Quarterly Dividend
summary: The Coca-Cola Company announced the election of three new corporate officers: Ellie May as vice president and controller, Mark Harris as vice president and general tax counsel, and Robin Halpern as vice president leading investor relations. The company also declared a regular quarterly dividend of 46 cents per common share, payable on July 3 to shareowners of record as of June 16. These appointments involve transitions as current officers retire or move into new roles within the company.

title: The Coca-Cola Company Elects Three Officers
summary: The Coca-Cola Company announced the election of three new corporate officers: Ellie May as vice president and controller, Mark Harris as general tax counsel, and Robin Halpern as vice president leading investor relations. These appointments coincide with the retirement of Kathy Loveless and Bob Jordan from their respective roles. The company also declared a regular quarterly dividend of 46 cents per common share.

title: El negocio de agua en garrafón de Bepensa impulsa las ventas de Coca-Cola Femsa
summary: Coca-Cola Femsa reported strong financial results for Q1 2023, with a 6.6% volume growth and 12.0% revenue increase, largely driven by its acquisition of Embotelladoras Bepensa's Cristal bottled water business. The company also announced expanded reach for its Juntos+ omni-channel platform and detailed efforts to address a recent cybersecurity incident while maintaining normal operations.

title: 3 Stocks Warren Buffett Has Owned the Longest
summary: Warren Buffett's investment strategy heavily relies on using time as an ally, with the average Berkshire Hathaway investment held for nearly seven years. This article highlights three long-term holdings: Coca-Cola, American Express, and Moody's, which Buffett has continuously owned for 35, 30, and 23 years, respectively. These companies benefit from consistent cash flow, strong brand recognition, cyclical financial sector growth, and subscription-based risk assessment services, leading to substantial returns and high dividend yields for Berkshire Hathaway.

title: Warren Buffett's lessons about dividends
summary: Warren Buffett emphasizes the significance of dividends as a "secret sauce" for investment returns, citing Coca-Cola and American Express as examples of long-term dividend growth. The article highlights how dividends contribute substantially to total stock market returns, often overlooked by investors solely focused on stock price appreciation. It also stresses the importance of selecting dividend-paying companies with strong economic moats, rather than just high yields, to ensure dividend consistency and growth potential.

title: Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway has been a fortress stock during recessions and bear markets. Here's how
summary: Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway has proven to be a resilient investment, consistently outperforming the S&P 500 during recessions and bear markets due to its long-term focus and conservative investment strategies. The conglomerate's significant stake in Apple, coupled with its substantial cash reserves and insurance ventures, underscores its "fortress stock" reputation. This approach has led to impressive compounded annual gains for Berkshire shareholders over decades.

title: Governor Hochul Announces Plans for the Coca-Cola Company to Build $650 Million fairlife® Production Facility in Monroe County | Empire State Development
summary: Governor Kathy Hochul announced that The Coca-Cola Company will build a $650 million fairlife production facility in Monroe County, New York, creating approximately 250 new jobs. This investment highlights New York's strong agribusiness sector and commitment to economic development in the Finger Lakes region. The facility, expected to be operational by Q4 2025, will significantly increase fairlife's production capacity for its ultra-filtered milk products.

title: Why Hain Celestial Stock Tumbled This Week
summary: Hain Celestial Group's stock fell 17% this week following a disappointing earnings report showing declining sales for the organic and natural food brands supplier. The company's performance, marked by decreasing overall sales and adjusted profits, contrasts with larger competitors like PepsiCo, which have managed to grow sales despite inflation. This indicates that Hain's premium brands are struggling more with current economic conditions, leading analysts to suggest investors stick with stronger-performing grocery brands.

title: Colgate-Palmolive beats Q4 profit estimates helped by price hikes
summary: Colgate-Palmolive (India) Ltd's fourth-quarter profit fell less than expected, helped by price hikes implemented to combat surging costs. The company reported a 2.3% fall in net profit to 3.16 billion rupees, while sales rose nearly 4% to 13.42 billion rupees due to price increases. Its better-than-feared earnings follow previous drops in profit and come as other consumer goods makers also report mixed earnings for the March quarter.

title: FSTA Top Holdings List & Exposure (Fidelity MSCI Consumer Staples Index ETF)
summary: This article details the top holdings and exposure of the Fidelity MSCI Consumer Staples Index ETF (FSTA). It lists the top 25 stocks held by the ETF, ranked by weight, which collectively make up 81.38% of the fund. Key holdings include Walmart, Costco Wholesale, and Procter & Gamble, providing a snapshot of FSTA's investment strategy in the consumer staples sector.

title: Omnicell Appoints Nchacha E. Etta as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
summary: Omnicell, Inc. (Nasdaq: OMCL) has announced the appointment of Nchacha E. Etta as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, effective June 1, 2023. Mr. Etta brings over two decades of finance and accounting experience, having previously served as CFO of Essilor of America, Inc., and held significant roles at Johnson & Johnson Vision, The Coca-Cola Company, Microsoft Corporation, and Eli Lilly and Company. He will succeed Peter J. Kuipers, who will remain with the company until July 1, 2023, for a smooth transition.

title: Coca-Cola and Its Bottlers Regress on Reuse Goal, Produce Billions More Single-Use Plastic Bottles
summary: Oceana reports that Coca-Cola and its bottling partners have regressed on their commitment to increase reusable packaging, leading to billions more single-use plastic bottles being produced. Despite a pledge to reach 25% reusable packaging by 2030, Coca-Cola's share of reusable packaging declined in 2022. Oceana urges Coca-Cola to enhance support for reusable containers and for bottlers to set more ambitious goals to prevent further plastic pollution.

title: “We have a lot of lives to reach”: $250,000 gift from Coca-Cola UNITED will help Live HealthSmart Alabama launch community leadership academies in underserved communities
summary: Live HealthSmart Alabama received a $250,000 gift from Birmingham's Coca-Cola Bottling Company UNITED, Inc. This funding will establish Community Leadership Academies in nine underserved communities, teaching residents skills to become local leaders. The initiative aims to empower community members to address health and social challenges, reflecting Coca-Cola UNITED's commitment to leadership and community investment.

title: How McDonald’s, P&G, Coca-Cola, GM and other big brands are spending on Black-owned media
summary: This article by Ad Age investigates how major brands such as McDonald's, P&G, Coca-Cola, and GM are allocating their advertising budgets towards Black-owned media companies. The content is based on a survey conducted by Ad Age focusing on the spending patterns of these large brands.

title: Simply Mixology and Masego Refresh L.A. Fans With Experiential ‘Bar Cart’
summary: Simply Mixology launched its new line of mixers with an experiential "Bar Cart" event in Los Angeles, co-designed by artist Masego. The event, held on a double-decker bus, offered cocktails and mocktails made with Simply's new Lime Margarita, Peach Sour, and Strawberry Guava Mojito flavors, catering to the growing trends of at-home mixology and sober curiosity. This initiative aims to elevate the brand's profile with younger generations and simplify the at-home drinking experience.

title: Examining the Importance of Dividend Growth
summary: This article contrasts dividend growth investing with high-yield strategies, highlighting its benefits like reduced volatility and steadily rising payouts. It uses Warren Buffett's investments in companies like Coca-Cola and American Express to demonstrate the long-term efficacy of reinvesting growing dividends. The piece concludes by suggesting dividend growth ETFs, such as the T. Rowe Price Dividend Growth ETF (TDVG), as an accessible option for retail investors.

title: Ellie May
summary: Ellie May serves as the Senior Vice President, Controller, and Chief Accounting Officer for The Coca-Cola Company, a role she took on in 2023. Prior to this, she gained extensive experience at Ernst & Young, holding various leadership positions including audit partner for multinational companies in retail and consumer products, and a partner in their National Accounting practice. May's career also includes international experience with Ernst & Young in Belgium and Germany, and she holds degrees from the University of Georgia and the University of Virginia.

title: Double Feature: Coke's Cinematic Connection With Drive-In Movie Theaters
summary: This article explores Coca-Cola's deep historical connection with drive-in movie theaters, highlighting how Coke became a staple in their concession stands from the 1950s and 1960s onward. It discusses Coca-Cola's tailored advertising strategies for drive-ins, including special dispensing machines and promotional materials. The piece also lists five of America's longest-running outdoor theaters, showcasing the enduring appeal of this nostalgic entertainment experience.

title: Topo Chico Ranch Water lacks tequila, adds sugar, class action alleges
summary: Molson Coors is facing a class action lawsuit over its Topo Chico Ranch Water hard seltzer, with allegations that the product misleads consumers into believing it contains tequila. Plaintiff Robert Younger claims the packaging's "100% Agave & Real Lime Juice" and agave plant imagery are deceptive, as the only agave ingredient used is agave syrup, a sweetener similar to sugar. The lawsuit further asserts that the vague ingredient listing of "Alcohol" is misleading, as it does not specify that the alcohol is derived from fermented sugar rather than tequila.

title: WPP shakes up creative process with AI-powered content engine
summary: WPP has partnered with Nvidia to launch a new AI-powered content engine aimed at transforming the creative process for clients. This engine, built on Nvidia's Omniverse Cloud, will leverage generative AI tools from Adobe and Getty Images to create more realistic and brand-accurate imagery and videos efficiently. The initiative positions WPP as a leader in AI adoption within the advertising industry, addressing the fast-paced demands of digital marketing and potential economic pressures.

title: Sigue el conflicto gremial con una embotelladora de Coca-Cola y amenaza con provocar faltantes en góndolas
summary: A labor dispute at a Coca-Cola bottling plant in Córdoba, Argentina, belonging to Coca-Cola Andina, threatens product shortages. The conflict stems from workers' claims of "unjustified dismissals" and demands for better labor rights and salaries, while the company asserts the conflict is politically motivated and without foundation. This situation has escalated to legal action due to alleged violent incidents.

title: Novelis to supply aluminum beverage can sheet to Coca-Cola
summary: Novelis Inc. has secured a multiyear agreement to supply aluminum can sheet to Coca-Cola's authorized North American bottlers. This partnership, which includes closed-loop recycling, reinforces Novelis's commitment to sustainability and supports Coca-Cola's "World Without Waste" targets. The agreement also highlights Novelis's expansion with its new Bay Minette, Alabama plant, set to open in 2025.

title: 3 Gold ETFs to Buy for Easy Exposure to the Precious Metal
summary: This article recommends three gold ETFs for investors seeking easy exposure to the precious metal amidst concerns about economic recession and inflation. The recommended funds are Graniteshares Gold Trust ETF (BAR), SPDR Gold Shares ETF (GLD), and iShares Gold Trust Micro (IAUM), each offering distinct advantages such as low fees, large asset holdings, or ultra-low expense ratios. The article highlights gold's role as a safe haven asset and notes its recent price strengthening and proximity to all-time highs.

title: Novelis Enters Long-Term Agreement to Supply Aluminum Beverage Can Sheet to The Coca-Cola System
summary: Novelis Inc. has signed a new long-term agreement with Coca-Cola Bottlers' Sales & Services Company, which is the contracting agent for The Coca-Cola Company's authorized North American bottlers. Under the agreement, Novelis will supply aluminum can sheet for Coca-Cola's iconic brands, including supply from Novelis' new plant in Bay Minette, Alabama, which is expected to begin commissioning in 2025. The contract also includes closed-loop recycling to promote sustainability, aligning with both companies' commitments to a greener future.

title: Limited Time Only Topo Chico Aguas Frescas Hard Seltzer Hits Shelves for Summer
summary: Topo Chico Aguas Frescas Hard Seltzer has launched a new, limited-time variety pack inspired by traditional aguas frescas. The hard seltzer features four fruit flavors—Passionfruit Mango, Citrus Tamarind, Ripe Watermelon, and Hibiscus Lime—each containing 100 calories and 4% ABV. This new line, produced by Molson Coors Beverage Company, aims to provide a unique and refreshing option for summer gatherings.

title: Turning plastic waste into purpose
summary: WWF and The Coca-Cola Company are collaborating on initiatives to address plastic waste, particularly in South Korea. Their campaigns, including "Plastic Waste Zero" and "ONETHEPL," focus on encouraging recycling, improving plastic collection, and creating a circular economy for plastics. A notable achievement includes turning collected plastic waste into essential PPE during the COVID-19 pandemic, which was then donated to medical institutions.

title: Time to Check Unfettered Power of Corporate Giants Over Health
summary: This article argues that corporate giants like Coca-Cola and Nestlé exert unfettered power over public health, climate, and equity, often through greenwashing and lobbying, while their products contribute to global health crises. It highlights how these commercial determinants of health require unified social movements and government regulation, citing Chile's success with food labeling laws as a model for effective intervention against corporate influence. The author advocates for identifying and combatting corporate maneuvers that prioritize profits over public well-being.

title: CCEP collaborates with Sidel on tethered bottle caps
summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP) is working with Sidel to implement tethered caps on its PET bottles across European factories to boost collection and recycling and reduce litter. This collaboration, building on over 30 years of partnership, involves converting existing Sidel lines to accommodate both the new tethered caps and a lighter GME30.40 neck. Pilot tests were conducted in Barcelona, and the first conversions began in April 2022, with the final line conversion scheduled for completion by the end of Q1 2024.

title: Coca-Cola scales for real-time personalisation with Adobe | Adobe Australia
summary: The Coca-Cola Company has partnered with Adobe to implement an Adobe Experience Cloud strategy for real-time personalization, aiming to engage its billions of consumers globally. By consolidating regional customer data platforms into a single view, Coca-Cola can deliver personalized messages, offers, and experiences across its diverse brand portfolio. This initiative led to significant improvements in email open rates and click-through rates for personalized campaigns, demonstrating the power of a centralized martech platform.

title: Coca-Cola scales for real-time personalization with Adobe
summary: The Coca-Cola Company is leveraging Adobe Experience Cloud, including Adobe Real-Time Customer Data Platform and Journey Optimizer, to achieve real-time personalization for billions of consumers globally. This strategic shift to an integrated IT platform has led to significant improvements in engagement, such as a 40% open rate for personalized rewards emails and a 63% uplift in click-through rates for personalized content. The company aims to consolidate all consumer information for targeted marketing and enhanced customer experiences across its diverse brand portfolio.

title: Coca-Cola HBC and Genpact Partner to Transform Operations and Drive Future Growth
summary: Coca-Cola HBC (CCH) and Genpact have announced a partnership to accelerate the digital transformation of CCH's finance operations. Genpact will leverage its expertise to drive process standardization and automation, aiming to enhance customer experiences and enable data-driven strategic actions for CCH. A new Genpact delivery center in Sofia, Bulgaria, will provide analytical capabilities to deliver insights in accounting, accounts payable, and cash collections.

title: Better Buy: Procter & Gamble vs. Clorox
summary: This article compares Procter & Gamble (PG) and Clorox (CLX), concluding that P&G is the better buy primarily due to its significantly larger marketing budget and ability to dominate competitive markets. While Clorox leads in niche categories, P&G's financial muscle allows it to consistently out-promote competitors and maintain an "unfair advantage" in consumer staples. The article emphasizes that P&G's size allows it to better navigate consumer price sensitivity and market competition.

title: Why IPG is betting quantum computing can reduce agency complexity
summary: Interpublic Group of Companies (IPG) has partnered with D-Wave Quantum to explore how quantum computing can enhance marketing efficiency, especially for complex tasks like audience segmentation and campaign optimization. Clients like Coca-Cola and Verizon are already experimenting with these new methods. IPG believes this futuristic technology will help agencies manage increasing complexity in the industry and free up human creativity from mundane tasks.

title: Coca-Cola Beverages Vietnam debuts Nutriboost Cookie and Cream
summary: Coca-Cola Beverages Vietnam has launched Nutriboost Cookie and Cream, a new milk and juice drink designed for the Vietnamese market. This product features an indulgent cookie and cream flavor combined with the "Energyze-blend" and contains reconstituted apple juice (10%) and milk (19%). The launch follows positive performance of Nutriboost in Indonesia, indicating a growing dairy segment for Coca-Cola in the region.

title: Walmart names Allyson Park chief communications officer
summary: Walmart Inc. has appointed Allyson Park as its new chief communications officer and senior vice president, effective July 26. Park brings 26 years of experience from prominent companies like Yum! Brands, Mars Wrigley, Mars Petcare, and The Coca-Cola Co., and will replace Brian Besanceney. Dan Bartlett, head of corporate affairs at Walmart, announced her appointment, highlighting her extensive background in corporate communications, global reputation, and international experience.

title: Goldman Sachs: C-Store Retailers ‘More Guarded’ on Beer Category Growth; Optimistic on Monster’s The Beast Unleashed
summary: Goldman Sachs' Q2 Beverage Bytes survey indicates that convenience store retailers are "more guarded" regarding beer category growth, projecting a 3% increase in dollar sales, down from earlier 6% expectations. This caution stems from economic pressures, cooler weather, and the ongoing impact of the Bud Light controversy. However, retailers are optimistic about energy drinks and Monster's Beast Unleashed, expecting strong performance from these categories.

title: Kenvue CEO says consumers are spending on brand-name health products even as they pull back in other areas
summary: Kenvue CEO Thibaut Mongon notes that consumers are prioritizing brand-name health and personal care products like Tylenol and Neutrogena, even as they cut spending in other areas. This trend, driven by a focus on health and trust in established brands, is also benefiting beauty and beverage companies that see less trade-down pressure. Kenvue expects continued strong demand, with 2023 sales projected to increase by 4.5% to 5.5%.

title: Coca-Cola raises guidance as income jumps 34%
summary: The Coca-Cola Co. raised its fiscal-year guidance after reporting a 34% increase in net income for the second quarter, reaching $2.55 billion. Despite battling inflation and private label competition in certain global markets, the company's net revenues grew 6% to $11.97 billion, driven by strong price/mix and concentrate sales growth. CEO James Robert B. Quincey noted easing supply chain pressures and stronger labor markets in developed regions, while also addressing increased consumer cost-consciousness and private label switching in particular categories.

title: P&G Beats Profit and Sales Estimates on Higher Prices
summary: Procter & Gamble (PG) surpassed profit and sales estimates for its fiscal 2023 fourth quarter, driven by higher prices for its products, even while facing increased costs. Shares rose over 3% following the announcement. However, the company's outlook for fiscal 2024 fell below forecasts due to anticipated macroeconomic challenges.

title: Republic and Ravago roll out network of olefin plants
summary: Republic Services and Ravago have formed a $350 million joint venture named Blue Polymers to establish four olefin plants across the U.S. These facilities, expected to be operational by 2028, will process sorted HDPE and PP from Republic's Polymer Centers into recycled pellet, aiming to produce 300 million pounds annually. This initiative represents Republic's "forward integration" strategy to meet growing demand for post-consumer resin.

title: Greenwashing Class Action Litigation: An Emerging Risk for Companies’ Claims of Sustainability
summary: Recent regulatory actions and consumer trends have led many companies to make public claims about their products' sustainability. This has, in turn, inspired a surge of "greenwashing" class-action lawsuits, alleging false advertising against companies unable to substantiate their claims. This article examines the factors driving this litigation trend, representative cases with varying outcomes, and offers recommendations for companies to minimize their exposure to such claims.

title: Aboitiz, Coca-Cola bottler CCEP to buy Coke Philippines for $1.8B
summary: Aboitiz Equity Ventures (AEV) and Coca-Cola Europacific Partners PLC (CCEP) are partnering to acquire Coca-Cola Philippines for $1.8 billion. AEV intends to secure a 40-percent stake, while CCEP will hold 60 percent, with the deal expected to close by the end of 2023 pending regulatory approvals and due diligence. This acquisition will diversify Aboitiz's portfolio and further expand CCEP's presence in the Asia-Pacific region.

title: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners in move to buy Philippines bottler
summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP) is moving to acquire Coca-Cola Beverages Philippines (CCBPI) in partnership with Aboitiz Equity Ventures, signing a letter of intent for a deal valued at $1.8bn. CCEP would hold 60% ownership. This planned acquisition follows CCEP's earlier full ownership of its Indonesian business and acquisition of Coca-Cola Amatil, further expanding its footprint in the Asia-Pacific region.

title: AB InBev’s Global Growth Offsets Bud Light Marketing Fiasco
summary: Anheuser-Busch InBev NV's profit growth exceeded analyst expectations, driven by strong sales in Brazil, China, and Colombia. This international growth successfully counterbalanced a significant 28% drop in US sales, which was attributed to the Bud Light marketing controversy. The company maintained its profit guidance for 2023, and its stock saw a notable increase.

title: Ball says Q2 volumes declined due to US beer controversy, Russia divestment
summary: Ball reported an 11% decline in global beverage volumes in Q2, primarily due to the sale of its Russian business and a "notable domestic beer brand experiencing demand disruption in North America." The company also maintained its free cash flow guidance for 2023 and is exploring options for its aerospace business.

title: How Mars, Colgate-Palmolive, Nestle & Coca-Cola are Exploring Generative AI
summary: This article details how major CPGs like Mars, Colgate-Palmolive, Nestle, and Coca-Cola are exploring generative AI to enhance efficiency, drive innovation, and improve consumer engagement. It highlights specific use cases ranging from pet health prediction and product formulation to marketing content creation and consumer experiences, while also emphasizing the critical need for responsible and ethical implementation of AI technologies. Each company is leveraging AI in unique ways to gain a competitive edge and redefine various operational and customer-facing functions.

title: Zendaya Keeps It Smart with smartwater – News & Articles
summary: smartwater and Zendaya are collaborating again in a new campaign to inspire individuals to "keep it smart" by challenging conventions and embracing their uniqueness. The campaign also features a partnership with the British Fashion Council to support emerging fashion designers, showcasing bespoke outfits from five designers. Additionally, smartwater and Zendaya are partnering with the Global Water Challenge, committing $200,000 in grants to improve clean water access, particularly supporting women and girls in communities worldwide.

title: Coconut Water Market Size & Share Analysis - Growth Trends & Forecasts (2023 - 2028)
summary: The coconut water market is projected to grow from USD 2.56 billion in 2023 to USD 4.27 billion by 2028, exhibiting a CAGR of 10.77%. This growth is driven by increasing consumer preference for natural and healthy beverages, particularly in the Asia-Pacific region, which dominates consumption. Despite concerns about unreported sugar content, sweetened coconut water remains a significant segment, with rising demand for immunity-boosting and functional drinks contributing to market expansion.

title: Branching Out — Learning from PepsiCo’s Challenges, Coca-Cola Slowly Grows into Alcohol
summary: Coca-Cola has launched a new subsidiary called Red Tree Beverages to manage its expansion into alcoholic beverages, taking a more cautious approach than PepsiCo, which faced regulatory scrutiny and sales challenges with its Blue Cloud division. Red Tree aims to give Coca-Cola greater control over how its billion-dollar brands are licensed and marketed in the alcohol space, without directly distributing or manufacturing alcoholic products. This strategy allows Coca-Cola to explore new opportunities in the converging beverage market while observing how regulations evolve and learning from a rival's experience.

title: ‘Masterpiece’ Collection Fetches More Than $500k in Coinbase Drop
summary: Coca-Cola's "Masterpiece" digital art collection sold for over $543,000 during Coinbase’s “Onchain Summer” event, celebrating the launch of its Base blockchain. The collection, which mingles classical paintings with contemporary art and Coca-Cola branding, draws inspiration from a global campaign and film. This initiative marks Coca-Cola's continued engagement with Web3 and NFTs, following previous collectibles for International Friendship Day and Pride Month.

title: Coca-Cola Hosts Digital Artists and Tech Enthusiasts for Generative AI Summit
summary: Coca-Cola hosted its first "Real Magic Creative Academy" in Atlanta, bringing together digital artists and tech enthusiasts to explore generative AI. The three-day summit included learning sessions and co-creation workshops, giving participants access to Coca-Cola brand assets and AI tools to develop new creative works. This initiative builds on Coca-Cola's "Create Real Magic" campaign, emphasizing the company's commitment to leveraging emerging technologies for artistic collaboration and innovation.

title: Who I’m Hurting By Shopping At Walmart
summary: The article explores the ethical dilemma of shopping at Walmart due to its impact on independent grocery stores. It discusses how Walmart's market power allows it to secure lower prices from suppliers, leading to a "waterbed effect" where smaller stores face higher costs and struggle to compete. The piece also details the Federal Trade Commission's renewed interest in enforcing the Robinson-Patman Act to level the playing field and protect small businesses, recognizing the impact on communities and consumer access to fresh food.

title: Southern Company and PGA TOUR partner to power TOUR Championship with 100% renewable energy for second consecutive year
summary: Southern Company has partnered with the PGA TOUR to power the TOUR Championship with 100% renewable energy for the second consecutive year, emphasizing their commitment to sustainability. The initiative includes renewable energy credits, renewable natural gas, zero-emission battery storage, electric golf carts, and renewable diesel. This effort aligns with Southern Company's goal of achieving net-zero emissions across its operations by 2050, having already reduced greenhouse gas emissions by 46% in 2022.

title: Freshpet strikes cooperative agreement with JANA Partners
summary: Freshpet has reached a cooperative agreement with activist investor JANA Partners following a recent proxy battle. The agreement includes the appointment of Timothy McLevish and Joseph E. Scalzo to Freshpet’s board of directors, bringing CPG leadership and financial expertise. JANA Partners has agreed to withdraw its previous director nominations and support Freshpet's slate of directors at the upcoming annual meeting.

title: The Coca-Cola Company and Partners Help Restore Drought-Stressed Watersheds in the Colorado River Basin
summary: The Coca-Cola Company, The Coca-Cola Foundation, and Swire Coca-Cola are actively supporting a project to restore drought-stressed watersheds in the Colorado River Basin. This initiative involves installing man-made beaver dams in Trail Creek to re-wet the landscape and support natural ecosystems. This effort is part of Coca-Cola's broader 2030 Water Security Strategy and a decade-long partnership with the National Forest Foundation to restore watersheds across the United States.

title: Self-care products set to grow big; no downtrading in healthcare, says Haleon CEO
summary: Haleon CEO Brian McNamara states that the self-care products market is poised for significant growth, driven by an increased focus on preventive healthcare post-pandemic and consumers' unwillingness to compromise on health. He notes that governments worldwide are also promoting self-care to alleviate pressure on healthcare systems. India is identified as a crucial growth market for Haleon, where the company sees little "downtrading" in healthcare products, including brands like Sensodyne.

title: Functional Water Market to surpass $12 Bn by 2032, Says Global Market Insights Inc.
summary: The functional water market is projected to exceed $12 billion by 2032, driven by increasing consumer health consciousness and demand for enhanced hydration options. Growth is particularly expected in the energy-enhanced water segment and for products packaged in pouches, which offer convenience and sustainability benefits. Europe is also anticipated to be a significant growth region due to health-conscious consumers and favorable regulatory environments.

title: Insider named a Leader in the 2023 Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Personalization Engines for the third year running with the highest scores for all three personalization use cases in the Critical Capabilities report.
summary: Insider has been recognized as a Leader in the 2023 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Personalization Engines for the third consecutive year. The company also achieved the highest scores for all three personalization use cases—Marketing, Digital Commerce, and Services and Support—in the Gartner Critical Capabilities report. Insider attributes its success to its agility, focus, and rapid deployment of innovative solutions like Generative AI, emphasizing its commitment to helping brands deliver individualized, cross-channel customer experiences and accelerate growth.

title: Coca-Cola North America grows under new president’s leadership, restructure and reinvestment
summary: Under the leadership of new president Jennifer Mann, Coca-Cola North America has seen significant growth in revenue (up 9%), expanded margins, and increased value and volume share within her first year. This success is attributed to a strategic reorganization that simplified the division's structure and route to market, along with reallocations of resources towards frontline marketing, innovation, and digital capabilities. While most of the portfolio is performing well, the sports beverage segment, particularly BodyArmor, is undergoing a focused action plan for improvement.

title: Coca-Cola introduces AI-designed beverage: Coca-Cola Y3000
summary: Coca-Cola has launched Coca-Cola Y3000, its first beverage developed with artificial intelligence, available in regular and zero-sugar. This product is part of a broader trend where food conglomerates like Mars, Beck's, and McCormick & Co. are utilizing AI for product development and operational efficiency. The Y3000 drink focuses on evoking a futuristic mood and is paired with an AI-powered experience and futuristic apparel, targeting younger, digitally-immersed consumers.

title: Better Stock Buy: Coca-Cola vs. Procter & Gamble
summary: This article compares Coca-Cola and Procter & Gamble, two major consumer staples companies, to determine which is a better stock buy. It highlights their similarities in business resilience and dividend history, while scrutinizing their differences in product offerings and, critically, their current valuations based on price-to-sales, price-to-earnings, and price-to-book ratios. The analysis concludes that Coca-Cola appears more attractively priced historically compared to P&G.

title: Here's why Johnson & Johnson just ditched one of the world's oldest logos
summary: Johnson & Johnson has replaced its iconic 135-year-old cursive logo with a cleaner, sans-serif design. This change reflects the company's shift in focus to innovative pharmaceuticals and medical devices after spinning off its consumer healthcare business. The new logo aims for better legibility and a more modern identity aligned with its updated corporate strategy.

title: Coca-Cola: The most valuable food and beverage brand
summary: Coca-Cola has been named the most valuable food and beverage brand, increasing its value by 9% year-over-year to $98 billion despite an overall market decline. This success is attributed to strong marketing investment, continuous innovation, and leveraging brand equity for pricing power. The company's long-standing commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) and leadership in sustainability also contribute significantly to its brand strength and consumer appeal.

title: Colgate, Coca-Cola detail packaging sustainability efforts at Pack Expo
summary: Colgate-Palmolive and Coca-Cola presented their sustainability initiatives at Pack Expo, highlighting successful transitions to more recyclable packaging materials and consumer education efforts. Both companies discussed the internal and external barriers encountered in achieving their ambitious sustainability goals, emphasizing the need for scientific approaches and widespread communication. They detailed specific product changes, such as Sprite's switch to clear PET bottles and Tom's of Maine's use of PCR, alongside broader operational strategies to reduce environmental impact.

title: Cisco to buy cybersecurity firm Splunk for $28 billion
summary: Cisco Systems agreed to acquire cybersecurity firm Splunk for approximately $28 billion, marking its largest-ever deal aimed at bolstering its software business and leveraging the AI boom. This acquisition is expected to reduce Cisco's reliance on its networking equipment business and accelerate revenue growth and gross margin expansion. Despite potential antitrust scrutiny, both companies anticipate the deal, valued at $157 per share for Splunk, to close by the end of the third quarter of 2024.

title: Coca-Cola HBC Austria Replacing Plastic Handles with Corrugated
summary: Coca-Cola HBC Austria, in collaboration with DS Smith and Krones, is introducing a new packaging solution to replace plastic handles on 1.5-liter PET soft drink multipacks. The DS Smith Lift Up corrugated handle system is 100% recyclable and is expected to reduce plastic use by around 200 tons annually. This initiative supports Coca-Cola HBC Austria's sustainability goals and net-zero emissions target by 2040.

title: Beer’s Hot Brands –
summary: The U.S. beer market is facing overall volume decline and competition from spirits and craft beers, but certain brands are achieving impressive growth. Twenty-seven beer, cider, and flavored malt beverage (FMB) brands were recognized as "Hot Brands" for their significant growth, with Mexican imports and FMBs leading the way. Modelo Especial continues to dominate the import market, while FMBs like Twisted Tea and new innovations from various beverage companies are driving category expansion.

title: Dividend Aristocrats may shine again if the Fed causes another bad year for the stock market
summary: The article suggests that Dividend Aristocrats, which performed well during the 2022 market downturn, could again be a strong investment if rising interest rates lead to another challenging year for the broader stock market. With investors becoming nervous due to increasing long-term rates, dividend stocks are presented as a potential safe haven. The piece indicates that the S&P Dividend Aristocrats, defined by S&P Dow Jones Indices, may warrant increased investor consideration.

title: 3 Must-Buy Stocks for the Coming Mexico Boom
summary: This article identifies three Mexican companies as "must-buy" stocks due to Mexico's burgeoning industries and potential economic growth. The recommended stocks are Grupo Financiero Banorte (GBOOY), Femsa (FMX), and Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacifico (PAC), highlighting their strong financial metrics, market positions, and growth prospects despite broader concerns about corruption in Mexico.

title: Coca-Cola & Beloved Local U.S. Pizzerias Are Offering Up Their Iconic Pizza In Exchange For Recycling A Bottle
summary: Coca-Cola is partnering with local pizzerias across the U.S. for "Toss In, Take Out," a traveling restaurant takeover event where consumers can exchange an empty plastic bottle for a slice of pizza and a Coca-Cola beverage. This initiative celebrates the expansion of Coca-Cola's 20-oz bottles made from 100% recycled plastic to new markets like Chicago, Atlanta, and the Pacific Northwest, aiming to reduce virgin plastic and CO2 emissions. The program supports Coca-Cola's "World Without Waste" goal of using at least 50% recycled material in bottles and cans by 2030 globally.

title: Coca-Cola Company and Pernod Ricard partner on Absolut Vodka with Sprite
summary: Coca-Cola Company and Pernod Ricard announced a partnership to launch a ready-to-drink Absolut Vodka & Sprite pre-mixed cocktail in early 2024, initially in select European countries. This move continues Coca-Cola's expansion into the alcohol space, leveraging its popular brands through various partnerships. The companies aim to capitalize on the growing ready-to-drink category and the popularity of vodka with lemon-lime mixers.

title: Pizza Fans Can Recycle Plastic Bottles for Free Slices and Coke Beverages | News Article
summary: Coca-Cola is launching a "Toss In, Take Out" program in New York, Atlanta, and Chicago to celebrate the expanded availability of bottles made from 100% recycled plastic. Consumers can bring any empty plastic beverage bottle to recycle and receive a free pizza slice and a 20-oz. Coca-Cola beverage in a 100% recycled plastic bottle. This initiative supports Coca-Cola's "World Without Waste" goal to reduce virgin plastic and promote a circular economy.

title: Signal: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners invests in research to turn carbon emissions into plastic
summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP) is investing in a project with Swansea University to convert captured carbon emissions into ethylene, a key component for plastics like bottle caps. This initiative, funded through CCEP Ventures, aims to replace traditional steam cracking methods, significantly reduce fossil fuel reliance and carbon emissions, and help CCEP achieve its net-zero goal by 2040. The research team will focus on developing an efficient CO2-to-ethylene process, with potential for scaling up to utilize CO2 from CCEP's factories.

title: Five reasons why... WPP has merged VMLY&R and Wunderman Thompson
summary: WPP has merged its agencies VMLY&R and Wunderman Thompson to form VML, creating the world's largest creative company. This strategic move aims to offer clients a comprehensive "one-stop shop" for brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, particularly leveraging advancements in AI. The merger also seeks to simplify client relationships, minimize duplication of capabilities, and provide strong competition against consulting firms.

title: Colgate-Palmolive Opens AI-Infused Plant to Propel Hill’s Growth
summary: Colgate-Palmolive has opened a new 365,000-square-foot AI-infused manufacturing plant in Tonganoxie, KS, for its Hill’s Pet Nutrition brand to overcome capacity constraints and drive growth. The advanced facility utilizes artificial intelligence, automation, and robotics, including automated guided vehicles and autonomous mobile robots, to enhance efficiency and food safety. This investment aims to boost Hill's Pet Nutrition's rapid growth, which has consistently been a strong performer for Colgate-Palmolive, and expand its presence in the wet pet food category.

title: Sysco breaks ground on Arizona distribution facility, to add 257 jobs
summary: Sysco Corp. has broken ground on Sysco Arizona East, a 353,600-square-foot distribution facility in Mesa, Arizona. The $102 million project is expected to create 257 jobs and be operational by Spring 2025. Sysco will offer training through its Operations Academy for eligible warehouse employees to earn a commercial driver's license.

title: The Untold Truth Of Farmer Brothers Coffee
summary: Farmer Brothers Coffee, established in 1912, has a long history of supplying coffee, tea, and spices, primarily to hotels, restaurants, and other institutions across the U.S., becoming a significant player despite not being a household name like Starbucks. The company faced challenges from founder's son's leadership, shareholder disputes, and a major relocation to Texas, which involved layoffs. Most recently, the COVID-19 pandemic significantly impacted its business, but stock market observers remain optimistic about its future recovery.

title: The Coca‑Cola Company is First to Launch Multiple Sparkling Brands in 100% Recycled Plastic Bottles* Across Canada
summary: The Coca-Cola Company is launching multiple sparkling brands in 100% recycled plastic bottles across Canada by early 2024, marking a significant step towards a circular economy for plastic packaging. This initiative, excluding caps and labels, is projected to save 7.6 million pounds of new plastic and reduce nearly 7,000 metric tons of CO2 emissions annually. To celebrate, Coca-Cola Canada is hosting "The Replay Arcade" in Toronto, encouraging consumers to recycle and experience the new bottles.

title: vitaminwater® and Chillhouse Drop Press-On Nails Collection
summary: vitaminwater® has partnered with Chillhouse to launch a unique collection of press-on nails, appealing to beauty lovers and promoting self-care. The collection features neutral and playful styles, including short-length options, with designs inspired by popular vitaminwater® flavors. These Chill Tips are available for purchase on Chillhouse.com and at their flagship store, offering an accessible way to express personal style.

title: Fox Factory to buy baseball-softball brand Marucci for $572 million
summary: Fox Factory is acquiring Marucci Sports, a baseball and softball equipment brand, for $572 million, marking its first acquisition in a new sports category since 2015. This acquisition diversifies Fox's sales towards the consumer market while the company reported a significant 58% decline in sales within its bicycle division for the most recent quarter. The company-wide revenues were down 19% and net income down 30% in the third quarter, which Fox attributes to high inventory levels and a challenging economic environment for consumers.

title: Oceana: Coca-Cola and Pepsi’s plastic packaging use increases by hundreds of millions of pounds
summary: Oceana reports that Coca-Cola and Pepsi increased their plastic packaging use by hundreds of millions of pounds in 2022, despite commitments to reduce virgin plastic and increase recycled content. The report, based on data from the Ellen MacArthur Foundation, highlights the companies' failure to make significant progress on reusable packaging, with Coca-Cola's share of reusable packaging declining and PepsiCo providing no data. Oceana urges both companies to prioritize refillable bottles to combat marine plastic pollution.

title: Monster Beverage lifts sales, earnings on expanding energy drink market
summary: Monster Beverage Corp. reported increased sales and earnings for Q3 2023, driven by the expanding energy drink market. Net sales rose 14.3% to $1.86 billion, with net income surging 40.4% to $452.7 million. Despite missing analysts' revenue expectations slightly, the company beat non-GAAP EPS estimates.

title: Ball raises its cup — and profile — with Kroenke Sports deal
summary: Ball Corp. has significantly boosted its profile and sustainability efforts through a wide-ranging marketing deal with Kroenke Sports & Entertainment, promoting its recyclable aluminum cups at major sports venues and events. The partnership has helped Ball showcase its commitment to environmental goals, including reducing emissions and increasing recycled content, while expanding production of its aluminum cups.

title: Tax Court Upholds Coca-Cola Transfer Pricing Adjustment
summary: The Tax Court has upheld a transfer pricing adjustment against Coca-Cola relating to its Brazilian manufacturing affiliate. The court found that a Brazilian legal restriction capping royalties did not block the payment of arm's-length compensation via dividends, and that Coca-Cola failed to demonstrate which of its intangible assets were covered by a grandfather clause pre-dating the blocked income regulation. As a result, the court sustained the entire $882 million net transfer-pricing adjustment.

title: Danone, Keurig Dr Pepper tell FDA that sugar reduction requires a different playbook from sodium reduction
summary: Food and beverage companies argue that sugar reduction requires a distinct approach compared to sodium reduction, as consumer preferences for sweetness are more stubborn. Experts at an FDA meeting suggested strategies like leveraging low- and no-calorie sweeteners, aggressive marketing of healthier options, and utilizing technology to create reduced-sugar products that still appeal to consumers. Danone and Keurig Dr Pepper shared their methods, including using specific flavors, cultures, and ultra-filtration, as well as promoting better-for-you alternatives in retail to shift consumption habits without sacrificing sales.

title: CCBA in Kenya hailed as beverage manufacturer of the year
summary: Coca-Cola Beverages Africa (CCBA) in Kenya has been named Manufacturer of the Year at the Kenya Beverage Excellence Awards, securing top spots in multiple drink categories including carbonated soft drinks, bottled water, energy drinks, and fruit juices. Additionally, CCBA in Kenya received the Sustainability Award, with 43% of consumers recognizing their efforts in sustainability. Managing Director James Bowmaker emphasized the company's commitment to quality products, innovation, and sustainable practices while driving growth for customers, the business, and communities.

title: Spotlight on XYLD: An S&P 500 Covered Call Strategy
summary: This article highlights the Global X S&P 500 Covered Call ETF (XYLD) as a strategy for investors looking to reduce volatility and generate income in the current market environment. It explains how XYLD uses a buy/write strategy by selling call options on the S&P 500 Index to produce a competitive yield, which exceeded 11% as of September 2023. The article also suggests that XYLD may be particularly appealing in a sideways-moving market, providing diversification and income for defensive investors.

title: Coca‑Cola® Creations Drops Futuristic AI Experience at Las Vegas Sphere
summary: Coca-Cola Creations launched "Destination Y3000," a weeklong AI-powered experience at the Las Vegas Sphere, showcasing their Y3000 Zero Sugar flavor co-created with human and artificial intelligence. The event featured futuristic visuals on the Sphere's exosphere and a VIP experience with Marshmello and the Jonas Brothers, emphasizing the blend of technology and real-world interactions. This initiative concludes Coca-Cola Creations' second year of limited-edition drops, focusing on innovation and engaging fans through digital and physical activations.

title: The Relative Strength Index (RSI) Indicator: Does It Work?
summary: This article explores the effectiveness of the Relative Strength Index (RSI) as a technical analysis indicator for predicting stock movements. It delves into the RSI's calculation, demonstrates its application using Python with examples like Coca-Cola and Omnicell, and analyzes its performance across the Russell 3000. The author concludes that while RSI alone offers modest returns, its effectiveness significantly improves when combined with fundamental analysis, especially when applied to mean-reverting or high-risk stocks, and can even be reversed for "breakout" stocks.

title: The Walt Disney Company Board Appoints Morgan Stanley's James P. Gorman and Veteran Media Executive Sir Jeremy Darroch as New Directors
summary: The Walt Disney Company has appointed James P. Gorman, Chairman and CEO of Morgan Stanley, and Sir Jeremy Darroch, former Group Chief Executive of Sky, to its Board of Directors. These appointments, effective January and February 2024 respectively, follow a comprehensive search and aim to strengthen the board with leaders experienced in financial institutions and international media. Concurrently, board member Francis A. deSouza will not seek re-election to pursue new opportunities in the technology sector.

title: Distributing Economic Opportunity Across the U.S.
summary: This article highlights Sterling Kilpatrick's 26-year career at Coca-Cola UNITED, showcasing how the Coca-Cola system provides stability, opportunity, and economic impact across the U.S. It details Kilpatrick's journey from a temp worker to a machine operator, emphasizing the company's investment in its employees and communities. The piece also quantifies the Coca-Cola system's significant economic footprint, supporting 854,000 jobs and contributing $58 billion to the U.S. economy in 2022.

title: |‘First of its kind’ $70M recycling facility opens in east valley
summary: |Republic Services has opened a "first of its kind" $70 million Polymer Center in the east valley of Las Vegas, capable of recycling rigid plastic materials such as water bottles into new consumer goods, rather than down-cycling them. This facility, a partnership with companies like Coca-Cola, aims to extend the life cycle of plastics, producing over 100 million pounds of recycled plastics annually and creating 65 jobs. The center is strategically located to serve the West Coast, especially with California's increasing demand for postconsumer recycled plastic in products.

title: Diageo does not plan to offload beer assets
summary: Diageo has refuted media reports suggesting it plans to sell off some of its beer brands while retaining Guinness. The company stated it does not comment on market speculation. In the last financial year, Diageo's beer sales were £3.36bn, with Guinness showing strong growth, despite a recent profit warning impacting its Latin America operations.

title: Republic Services opens Las Vegas polymer center to supply recycled plastic for packaging
summary: Republic Services has launched its first polymer center in Las Vegas, aiming to produce over 100 million pounds of recycled plastics annually to address the demand for sustainable packaging. This facility, part of a planned national network, represents a $70 million investment and will supply recycled PET, HDPE, and polypropylene. Coca-Cola is the inaugural customer, committing to use recycled PET from the center starting January as part of its goal to incorporate 50% recycled material in its packaging by 2030.

title: Republic Services Polymer Center opens in Las Vegas
summary: Republic Services Inc. has opened its Polymer Center in Las Vegas, the first of its kind in North America, to produce over 100 million pounds of recycled plastics annually for use in sustainable packaging. The facility will process plastic bottles, jugs, and containers into rPET, HDPE, and PP, extending the lifecycle of plastic packaging and addressing the growing demand for recycled content. Coca-Cola is an early customer, and Republic plans to expand its network of Polymer Centers nationwide, with a second facility opening in Indianapolis in late 2024.

title: Vita Coco founder: Here's the No. 1 mindset that grew my company from $0 to $1.5 billion
summary: Michael Kirban, co-founder of Vita Coco, attributes his company's growth to a competitive mindset, turning threats into motivation. He explains how a rivalry with Zico fueled Vita Coco's journey from a startup to a $1.5 billion market cap leader. Kirban emphasizes embracing competition and the "underdog" mentality to achieve success and prove skeptics wrong.

title: Down 10% This Year Is Coca-Cola Stock A Better Pick Over AbbVie?
summary: This article compares Coca-Cola (KO) and AbbVie (ABBV) stocks, both with similar market capitalizations, to determine which offers better investment prospects. While AbbVie has shown better historical revenue growth and profitability, Coca-Cola is favored for future returns due to its better financial position and valuation metrics, especially as AbbVie faces declining sales from its blockbuster drug Humira.

title: DDB elevates Tomas Gonsorcik to global chief strategy officer
summary: DDB has promoted Tomas Gonsorcik to global chief strategy officer, a role he will undertake from the agency's NYC headquarters. Gonsorcik previously served as chief strategy officer for DDB in North America and brings extensive experience from leading strategy for major global brands. In his new position, he aims to standardize tools and processes across DDB's global network while allowing local agencies to maintain flexibility and adapt to market needs, emphasizing a "pull versus push" leadership approach.

title: Ball and Coca-Cola join forces to trial carbon-cutting trucks in the UK
summary: Ball Beverage Packaging and Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP) are collaborating in the UK to trial hydrotreated vegetable oil (HVO) part-fueled trucks to reduce carbon emissions. This 12-month trial, supported by Menzies Distribution, aims to cut UK supply chain CO2e emissions by approximately 300 tons, with potential reductions of up to 90% if fully implemented. The initiative aligns with both companies' climate transition plans to achieve net-zero emissions and decarbonize their operations.

title: Best Selling Alcohol-Free Beer In America
summary: Heineken 0.0 is identified as the top-selling alcohol-free beer in America, benefiting from its parent company's brand recognition. Large brewers like AB InBev and Diageo are making substantial investments in the non-alcoholic segment, with goals for it to comprise a significant portion of their sales. The move is driven by consumer health concerns, including alcohol avoidance and lower calorie options, positioning non-alcoholic beers as a critical brand extension in a competitive market.

title: How much do food and beverage CEOs really make?
summary: A new SEC rule mandates public companies to report a "compensation actually paid" figure for executives, providing greater transparency into CEO earnings, especially stock awards. This rule reveals significant discrepancies between previously reported compensation and actual earnings, with some food and beverage CEOs seeing millions more in undisclosed compensation. The change aims to allow investors to better evaluate executive pay against company performance.

title: Bottled Water Market Projected to Soar to USD 551.2 Billion by 2033 | Remarkable CAGR of 5.3%
summary: The global bottled water market is projected to reach USD 551.2 billion by 2033, growing at a CAGR of 5.3% from 2023 to 2033, driven by increasing health consciousness and convenience. Still water and plastic bottles currently dominate the market, but there's a growing trend towards functional waters, sustainable packaging, and e-commerce distribution. Asia Pacific holds the largest market share, with major players like Nestlé and PepsiCo innovating in product offerings and eco-friendly solutions.

title: 2,000 cases of soda recalled, may be contaminated with 'foreign material'
summary: Coca-Cola has issued a voluntary recall for approximately 2,000 cases of Diet Coke, Sprite, and Fanta Orange across Alabama, Mississippi, and Florida due to potential contamination with unidentified "foreign material." The FDA did not specify the nature of the material or associated risks, but said the recall was initiated by Coca-Cola on November 6, and the company confirmed all affected products have been removed from store shelves. Customers can return the recalled soda for a refund or exchange.

title: Low/no alcohol spearheading growth for market
summary: The low and no-alcohol beverage market is experiencing significant growth, primarily driven by no-alcohol products and consumer interest in "sober curious" lifestyles and health considerations. While the U.S. market is less developed than European counterparts, premiumization and functional benefits are key trends attracting consumers and supporting higher price points. Experts predict continued growth, influenced by factors like new GLP-1 diet drugs, cannabis legalization, and a general shift towards healthier living, though education and awareness will be crucial for broader adoption.

title: TD Cowen Research Unveils Shift In Consumer Behavior Towards Cannabis & Away From Alcohol
summary: A new report by TD Cowen analyst Vivien Azer indicates a significant shift in consumer behavior, showing that legal cannabis sales are negatively impacting alcohol sales. The research projects U.S. cannabis sales to grow to $29 billion by 2023 with a 7% CAGR over the next five years, attracting 18 million new users while potentially decreasing alcohol users by 2 million. States with legal cannabis, like Colorado, show notable underperformance in alcohol sales compared to non-cannabis states, suggesting a lasting market transformation.

title: Here Are All 49 Stocks Warren Buffett Holds for Berkshire Hathaway's $371 Billion Portfolio
summary: This article details the 49 stocks held in Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway portfolio, valued at $371 billion. It highlights that over 85% of the assets are concentrated in eight major holdings like Apple and Bank of America, while also listing other billion-dollar investments and smaller holdings attributed to Buffett's lieutenants. The piece emphasizes Buffett's preference for financial and cyclical businesses, his valuation-driven approach, and recent investments in homebuilders.

title: The Coca-Cola Company Renews as Proud Partner of the TOUR Championship
summary: The Coca-Cola Company has renewed its sponsorship as a Proud Partner of the TOUR Championship through 2027 and signed a new five-year Official Marketing Partnership with the PGA TOUR, making it the Official Soft Drink of the PGA TOUR. This extended partnership highlights Coca-Cola's significant role in the tournament's charitable contributions, which include over $48 million raised to date and a record $5.5 million donation in 2022. Coca-Cola's involvement has also been crucial in initiatives like the TOUR Championship Charity Challenge, benefiting the East Lake Foundation and other charitable partners in Atlanta.

title: Republic Services Polymer Center, Las Vegas, USA
summary: Republic Services launched its first Polymer Center in Las Vegas, US, in December 2023, aiming to annually produce 100 million pounds of recycled plastics for consumer packaging. This facility is part of a broader network Republic Services is developing to meet the rising demand for recycled plastics and enhance the circularity of plastic packaging. The center employs advanced recycling technologies to convert various rigid plastics, including PET and olefins, into high-quality materials for reuse.

title: Coca-Cola, Hillenbrand seeking circular plastic case studies
summary: Hillenbrand, The Coca-Cola Co., and Net Impact are coordinating the second annual Circular Plastics Case Competition, aiming to unearth innovative strategies to increase the supply of postconsumer recycled material (PCR), specifically rPET. The competition encourages emerging business professionals to design solutions for a more circular plastics economy, with finalists presenting their ideas during the NPE event and winners receiving cash prizes. This initiative seeks to address the current supply challenges of rPET and foster sustainability within the plastics value chain.

title: Two decades after its founding, Vita Coco is still fighting to silence skeptics
summary: Vita Coco, two decades after its founding, continues to battle skeptics despite its success and growth in the coconut water market. Co-founder Mike Kirban, fueled by childhood struggles and doubters, has built a profitable business that withstood competition from beverage giants and a demand downturn. The company, now a public entity, is outperforming major beverage categories and looking to expand into other drink segments while maintaining its core business.

title: Éstas son las empresas que construyeron la fortuna de Eva Gonda Rivera, la segunda mujer más rica de México
summary: Eva Gonda Rivera is the second wealthiest woman in Mexico, inheriting her fortune from her late husband, Eugenio Garza Lagüera. She controls 50% of FEMSA shares, a prominent Mexican conglomerate known for its Coca-Cola FEMSA bottling operations and the popular OXXO convenience stores. In November 2023, her net worth was estimated at $5.841 billion.

title: 3 Boring Stocks to Buy and Hold Forever: January 2024
summary: This article recommends three "boring" but reliable stocks for long-term investors: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A/BRK.B), Costco (COST), and McDonald's (MCD). These companies are highlighted for their consistent performance, strong business models, and shareholder-friendly practices, including dividends and steady growth, despite not being flashy. The author advocates for a buy-and-hold strategy, emphasizing that such predictable investments often lead to significant long-term returns.

title: How The Coca-Cola System Refreshes Local Economies and Communities in Markets Around the World
summary: The Coca-Cola system, a global company with local roots, significantly contributes to local economies worldwide by creating jobs, supporting local suppliers, and generating economic value. Operating through a unique model of independent bottling partners, the system supports nearly 700,000 employees globally and has a substantial economic impact in diverse regions like the U.S., Latin America, Italy, South Africa, and India. Beyond economic contributions, the Coca-Cola system also fosters community development through volunteerism, donations, and grants supporting environmental and social priorities.

title: Novelis to supply Ardagh Metal Packaging
summary: Novelis Inc. has secured a new contract to supply aluminum beverage packaging sheet to Ardagh Metal Packaging USA Corp.'s North American facilities. This marks Novelis's third major contract in seven months within the North American beverage packaging market, driven by increasing consumer demand for sustainable options. The company anticipates global demand for aluminum beverage packaging sheet to grow at a 4 percent compounded annual growth rate between 2023 and 2031.

title: Coca-Cola pilot removes labels from Sprite bottles to ease recycling
summary: Coca-Cola has launched a limited trial of label-less 500mL Sprite and Sprite Zero bottles in British supermarkets to further ease recycling and reduce packaging material. The initiative follows the company's 2022 move to switch Sprite bottles from green to clear PET to improve bottle-to-bottle circularity. The company aims for all its packaging to be recyclable by 2025 and to cut 3 million metric tons of virgin plastic by 2025 from a 2020 baseline.

title: CCEP trials plastic Sprite bottles with no wrap-around labelling
summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP) has launched a trial in the UK for Sprite and Sprite Zero 500ml rPET bottles that feature no plastic wrap-around labels. Instead, the bottles are laser-engraved with product information, aiming to explore more sustainable packaging solutions. This initiative seeks to simplify the recycling process by removing the need to separate labels from the plastic bottles.

title: Major Brands Like McDonald’s, Kroger and Coca-Cola Linked to Forced Prison Labor
summary: A two-year Associated Press investigation has revealed that forced prison labor is extensively integrated into the supply chains of numerous food and grocery companies, from small brands to major conglomerates like McDonald's, Coca-Cola, and Kroger. Prisoners, who are disproportionately Black, are often forced to work for pennies or nothing, facing abuse and dangerous conditions, while states, prisons, and corporations profit millions. This system is described by formerly incarcerated individuals as modern-day slavery, with workers lacking basic labor rights and often being exploited in conditions reminiscent of historical forced labor.

title: Aboitiz gets PCC nod for P40-B Coke Philippines investment
summary: Aboitiz Equity Ventures Inc. (AEV) has secured approval from the Philippine Competition Commission for its P40-billion investment to acquire a 40-percent stake in Coca-Cola Beverages Philippines Inc. The conglomerate expects to finalize the acquisition by the end of February, further diversifying its portfolio into the branded consumer goods sector. This move is anticipated to be immediately accretive for Aboitiz, with analysts noting the potential for increased profitability for Coca-Cola Philippines as sugar prices normalize and inflation eases.

title: 48-year-old started with $75,000 in savings and multiple maxed-out credit cards—and built a $1.1 billion company
summary: Michael Kirban and Ira Liran co-founded Vita Coco, a coconut water company, after a chance encounter in 2003 inspired them to bring the popular Brazilian beverage to the U.S. They started with a $75,000 investment and navigated early challenges, including regulatory hurdles and intense competition. Kirban notably used a risky credit card strategy, moving balances to new zero-interest cards, to avoid business loans and retain control of the company, which is now valued at $1.1 billion.

title: ¿Cuáles son los CEDEAR más elegidos por los argentinos?
summary: Certificados de Depósito Argentinos (CEDEAR) are a popular investment option in Argentina for diversifying portfolios and hedging against peso devaluation by investing in foreign companies. In January, Coca-Cola (KO) was the most chosen CEDEAR, followed by Apple (AAPL) and Tesla (TSLA). Recent changes by Banco Comafi regarding conversion ratios aim to make CEDEARs more accessible to a wider range of investors by lowering entry prices.

title: How quantum computing technology solves real-world business challenges
summary: Momentum Worldwide, an experiential marketing agency, is using quantum computing to optimize its operations, demonstrating a practical application of the technology. The company partnered with D-Wave to develop a prototype solution that efficiently solves complex logistical problems for large-scale marketing tours in under an hour. This shift from theoretical to practical application highlights quantum computing's potential to significantly enhance efficiency and quality of life for workers in various industries.

title: US Congressman accuses Alcoa, Century, Rio Tinto of anti-competitive behavior in aluminium market | Hotter Commodities
