summary: A US Congressman, Ken Buck, has accused major aluminium producers including Alcoa, Century Aluminum, and Rio Tinto of anti-competitive price collusion. Buck alleges these companies include a tariff in the price of aluminium products sold to beverage companies, despite the majority of the metal being exempt from such tariffs, leading to unjustified windfall payments. He has introduced legislation to expand the US False Claims Act to address this issue, arguing that these practices artificially inflate aluminium prices and hurt consumers.

title: Coca-Cola debuts Coca-Cola Spiced as permanent addition to portfolio
summary: Coca-Cola is expanding its permanent flavor portfolio with the introduction of Coca-Cola Spiced in North America, blending the classic taste with raspberry and spiced notes. This new offering, available in both regular and Zero Sugar versions, comes in response to a significant rise in consumer interest in spiced and raspberry flavors in beverages. Concurrently, the Coca-Cola Creations series has launched its latest limited edition, Coca-Cola Happy Tears Zero Sugar, designed to celebrate kindness and exclusively sold via TikTok.

title: Top stock reports to watch this week (12.02.2024)
summary: The Wall Street earnings season for Q4 2023 is ongoing, with most large-cap companies already reporting, but a significant portion of small-cap companies (Russell 2000) are yet to release their results. This week features reports from key companies like Arista Networks, Coca-Cola, Robinhood Markets, Barrick Gold, and Coinbase. The article provides a breakdown of how many companies across various US indices have reported their Q4 2023 earnings.

title: Kraft Heinz Stock Slides as Higher Prices and Industry Headwinds Send Sales Tumbling
summary: Kraft Heinz (KHC) shares fell over 6% after the company reported a 7.1% decline in Q4 revenue to $6.86 billion, missing estimates, due to higher prices and falling consumer demand. The company cited industry headwinds, including cuts to the federal Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), as factors impacting sales. Kraft Heinz expects full-year organic net sales growth for 2024 to be flat to up 2%, a slowdown from 2023, while adjusted gross profit margin is projected to increase by 25 to 75 basis points, significantly below the previous year's jump.

title: Is Coca‑Cola Zero Sugar the ‘Best Coke Ever?’
summary: Coca-Cola Zero Sugar is launching a new digital-driven marketing campaign to assert itself as the "Best Coke Ever?", two years after its reformulation. The campaign uses AI-generated typography to make the product "speak for itself" and incorporates music-focused activations, including using *NSYNC's "It's Gonna Be Me" as an anthem and inviting fans to remix Coke Zero sounds. This initiative aims to build on the beverage's strong growth and engagement through creative experiences.

title: Board of Directors of The Coca-Cola Company Approves 62nd Consecutive Annual Dividend Increase
summary: The Board of Directors of The Coca-Cola Company (KO) has approved its 62nd consecutive annual dividend increase, raising the quarterly dividend by 5.4% from 46 cents to 48.5 cents per common share. This translates to an annual dividend of $1.94 per share. This first-quarter dividend is payable on April 1 to shareowners of record as of March 15. The company returned $8 billion in dividends in 2023.

title: Coca Cola Andina volverá a abrir sus puertas en Godoy Cruz con una nueva línea de empaques retornables
summary: Coca Cola Andina is reopening its plant in Godoy Cruz after 20 years, investing U$S 30 million in a new line for returnable packaging. This initiative is expected to create over 50 direct and 150 indirect jobs, reinforcing the company's commitment to sustainable production and the province's growth. The new line will offer returnable PET and glass bottles, contributing to environmental care and offering a more economical option for consumers.

title: Coca-Cola manages to increase volume in 2023
summary: Coca-Cola reported a 2% increase in unit case volume for the fiscal year ended Dec. 31, 2023, driven primarily by Coca-Cola Zero Sugar. The company also saw increases in net income and revenues, with organic revenues growing by 12%. Despite a slight dip in North American volume, Coca-Cola is focused on expanding packaging options for affordability and premiumization, and expects continued organic revenue growth in the current fiscal year.

title: ADA allowed Coca-Cola bottler to reassign driver with Tourette syndrome to warehouse, court rules
summary: The 6th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that Coca-Cola Consolidated Inc. was justified in reassigning a delivery driver with Tourette syndrome to a warehouse role. The court found that because the driver's involuntary use of profanity and slurs offended customers, he could not perform an essential function of his delivery job. The reassignment, which resulted in a slight pay cut, was deemed a reasonable accommodation given the unavailability of a non-customer-facing delivery route.

title: General Mills rolls out MillsChat, an internal generative AI tool
summary: General Mills has launched MillsChat, a private generative AI tool built on Google's PaLM 2 model, for its employees in the U.S., Canada, U.K., and India. The tool is designed to assist with writing, summarizing, and brainstorming in a secure environment. This initiative reflects General Mills' increasing investment in AI, having grown its data science headcount fortyfold since 2018, and aligns with other food brands like Kraft Heinz, Coca-Cola, and Procter & Gamble that are also integrating generative AI into their operations to improve business outcomes and operational efficiencies despite a challenging consumer landscape.

title: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners Full Year 2023 Financial Results
summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP) announced solid top and bottom-line growth and impressive free cash flow for the full year 2023, attributing success to leading brands, strong customer relationships, and in-market execution. The company is well-positioned for FY24, with strategic investments including the acquisition of Coca-Cola Beverages Philippines, and anticipates continued shareholder value through a record dividend and Nasdaq 100 inclusion. CCEP plans to focus on major events like the Paris Olympics and UEFA Euros to boost engagement and manage pricing to balance affordability and premiumisation.

title: Discussing the acquisition of Coca-Cola Beverages Philippines Inc. and the future of CCEP
summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP) is set to integrate Coca-Cola Beverages Philippines Inc. (CCBPI) starting February 26th, marking a significant expansion for CCEP. This acquisition, a joint venture with Aboitiz Equity Ventures (AEV), follows the 2021 Amatil acquisition and will further diversify CCEP's business, increasing its reach and scale globally. Chairman Sol Daurella and CEO Damian Gammell highlight the strategic importance of this move for growth, sustainability, and opportunities for employees, customers, and shareholders.

title: Aboitiz, CCEP complete $1.8 billion Coca-Cola Beverages PH acquisition
summary: Aboitiz Equity Ventures Inc. (AEV) and Coca-Cola Europacific Partners Plc (CCEP) have finalized their $1.8 billion acquisition of Coca-Cola Beverages Philippines Inc. (CCBPI) from The Coca-Cola Company. The new ownership structure for CCBPI will see CCEP holding 60% and AEV 40%. This acquisition aligns with AEV's strategy for portfolio diversification into branded consumer goods and builds on CCEP's previous expansion initiatives.

title: Aboitiz, partner complete $1.8-B acquisition of Coke PH
summary: Aboitiz Equity Ventures Inc. (AEV) and Coca-Cola Europacific Partners Plc (CCEP) have finalized their $1.8-billion acquisition of Coca-Cola Beverages Philippines Inc. (CCBPI) from The Coca-Cola Company (TCCC). CCEP will own 60% of CCBPI, while AEV will hold the remaining 40%, a move that diversifies AEV's portfolio and leverages CCEP's successful expansion in the Asia Pacific region. The acquisition, recently approved by the Philippine Competition Commission, was partly funded by AEV's P17.45 billion bond issuance.

title: Aboitiz, partner seal P100-B buyout of Coca-Cola Philippines
summary: The Aboitiz Group and Coca-Cola Europacific Partners Plc (CCEP) have finalized their P100-billion acquisition of Coca-Cola Beverages Philippines Inc. Aboitiz Equity Ventures (AEV) now owns 40%, while CCEP holds 60% of the Philippine unit. This deal allows Aboitiz to expand into consumer segments and leverage Coca-Cola Philippines' attractive profitability, which reported nearly P95 billion in revenue and P2.2 billion in net income in 2022.

title: Coffee remains a concern for Keurig Dr Pepper
summary: Keurig Dr Pepper experienced a downturn in its US at-home coffee market segment in 2023, with net sales falling 5.4% and volume/mix declining 7.9% for the US Coffee business. Despite this, the company posted positive overall results for fiscal 2023, driven by strong performance in its US Refreshment Beverages and International segments. Keurig Dr Pepper anticipates continued strong momentum in these areas for 2024, with a muted contribution expected from US Coffee.

title: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners completes joint acquisition of Coca-Cola Beverages Philippines
summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP), in a joint venture with Aboitiz Equity Ventures (AEV), has finalized the acquisition of Coca-Cola Beverages Philippines (CCBPI) for $1.8bn. This deal, with a 60:40 ownership structure between CCEP and AEV, significantly expands CCEP's presence in high-growth Asian markets and solidifies its position as the world's largest Coca-Cola bottler by both revenue and volume. The acquisition is expected to leverage CCEP's established strategies and contribute to growth in the Philippines and potentially other key markets like Indonesia.

title: Coca-Cola Andina invierte US$30 millones y reabre una fábrica cerrada por 20 años
summary: Coca-Cola Andina has invested US$30 million to reopen a factory in Godoy Cruz, Mendoza, that had been closed for 20 years. This initiative is expected to create around 200 jobs and expand the company's presence in the Cuyo region, focusing on sustainable, returnable packaging. The investment was facilitated by Argentina's Import Regime for Components of Large Investment Projects, which exempts companies from customs duties on new machinery for production lines.

title: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plans $1bn expansion in the Philippines
summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP) plans to invest $1 billion in its Philippine operations over the next five years. This announcement follows CCEP's acquisition of Coca-Cola Beverages Philippines in a joint venture with Aboitiz Equity Ventures (AEV), where AEV holds a 40% stake and CCEP holds 60%. The expansion highlights Coca-Cola's continued global investment, particularly in the Asia-Pacific region.

title: Latest Coca-Cola® Creations Drop Celebrates and Connects K-Pop Fans With Coca-Cola® K-WAVE Zero Sugar
summary: Coca-Cola Creations has launched "K-WAVE Zero Sugar," a limited-edition flavor celebrating K-Pop fandom. This new drink combines the iconic Coca-Cola taste with a fruity K-Pop magic, aiming to connect fans and artists through digital experiences, a new anthem "Like Magic" featuring Stray Kids, ITZY, and NMIXX, and an exclusive K-Pop concert on June 2. The initiative also includes a fashion collaboration with PRIVATE POLICY and an immersive AI experience for fans to integrate themselves into the "Like Magic" music video.

title: Activist investor group seeks Elanco CEO ouster, shakeup of board
summary: An activist investor group, Ancora Holdings Group LLC, is pushing for a shakeup of Elanco Animal Health Inc.'s board of directors and the removal of CEO Jeff Simmons. Ancora, which holds about 3% of Elanco’s shares, claims the company has underperformed its peers and destroyed significant shareholder value through poor margins and sluggish drug commercialization. Elanco, in response, asserts its "innovation, portfolio and productivity" strategy is working and that it has returned to growth.

title: Wendy’s Dynamic Pricing Announcement Puts New CEO Kirk Tanner In Spotlight
summary: Wendy's new CEO, Kirk Tanner, faced public backlash after announcing plans for dynamic pricing, including surge pricing during peak hours, to increase profit margins. Although Wendy's later clarified that digital menus would allow for discounts during slower periods, the initial announcement sparked criticism and led competitors, like Burger King, to highlight their opposition to such pricing strategies. The controversy underscores the challenges companies face when implementing new pricing models, especially for essential goods, and the importance of clear communication to avoid misinterpretations.

title: 3 Warren Buffett Stocks to Own Forever
summary: Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway recently published its 2023 annual report, identifying several stocks the company expects to hold indefinitely. This article highlights three of these "forever stocks": Coca-Cola, American Express, and Occidental Petroleum. All three are considered hugely successful in their base businesses with global brands or essential services, making them attractive long-term investments according to Buffett.

title: 7 Reasons to Avoid PepsiCo (PEP) Immediately
summary: This article outlines seven reasons why investors should consider avoiding PepsiCo (PEP) stock. The concerns include its expensive valuation relative to benchmarks, declining net cash balance and cash flow from operations, intense competition in both beverage and snack markets, and weak organic revenue growth. Additionally, the article highlights the negative impact of inflation on profit margins, significantly lagging earnings growth compared to the subsector, and a weakening financial health reflected in its current ratio and increasing debt.

title: Topo Chico Launches Line of Premium Mixers
summary: Topo Chico is expanding its product line in the United States with the launch of new premium mixers. These non-alcoholic mixers, inspired by Topo Chico Mineral Water's taste, come in Ginger Beer, Tonic Water, and Club Soda flavors. The move builds on Topo Chico's history as a popular mixer and its recent expansion into hard seltzers and sparkling waters.

title: Warren Buffett Plans to Step Down as CEO of Berkshire Hathaway at End of 2025
summary: Warren Buffett announced he plans to step down as CEO of Berkshire Hathaway at the end of 2025, recommending Greg Abel as his successor, a move the board unanimously approved. Buffett will remain chairman, focusing on potential large acquisitions. Morningstar analysts suggest that while Buffett's departure is significant, Berkshire's decentralized structure and institutionalized culture of management autonomy will enable a smooth transition, potentially leading to the company returning more capital to shareholders through dividends.

title: Keurig Dr Pepper Tests Plastic-Free Pods, Powers Innovation With Consumer Learnings
summary: Keurig Dr Pepper is developing plastic-free coffee pods called K-Rounds, along with new Keurig Alta brewers, as part of a multi-year strategy to integrate consumer insights and enhance sustainability. These new pods use pressed coffee beans in plant-based wrapping, will be compostable, and are designed for both espresso and drip coffee at varying pressures. The company also announced a new K-Brew + Chill Brewer and an expanded mail-back recycling program for existing K-Cup pods.

title: People on the move: New appointments in the beverage industry - Coca-Cola, Constellation Brands and more
summary: Several major beverage companies have announced new leadership appointments. Constellation Brands has named Sam Glaetzer as the new EVP and President of its Wine & Spirits Division at a pivotal time for the segment. The Coca-Cola Company is seeing changes in its ASEAN & South Pacific operating unit with Selman Careaga taking over, and Claudia Lorenzo becoming Chief of Staff to the CEO.

title: Monster Lays Off 12 Cigar City Workers in Tampa, Transitions Brewery to Cross-Category Innovation Hub
summary: Monster-owned Cigar City Brewing in Tampa, Florida, is transitioning its production hub into a cross-category innovation center for beer, FMBs, and spirits, leading to the termination of 12 positions, including long-time brewmaster Wayne Wambles. Cigar City beers will now be produced at Oskar Blues Brewery in North Carolina, though Cigar City's taprooms in Tampa will remain open and serve small-batch beer brewed locally. This restructuring follows Monster's earlier acquisition of the CANarchy craft beer platform and an impairment charge on its alcohol business, reflecting ongoing challenges in the craft beer and seltzer categories.

title: Vietnam third largest market for Hong Kong-based Coca-Cola bottler
summary: Hong Kong-based Swire Pacific, a Coca-Cola bottler, reported that Vietnam became its third-largest market globally in 2023, with sales reaching 155 million unit cases. This follows the acquisition of the Coca-Cola franchise in Vietnam by its subsidiary, Swire Coca-Cola, in January 2023. Despite slower economic growth, the company expects steady profits from its Vietnam operations, even though per capita consumption there is the lowest among its markets.

title: Kraft Heinz, king of condiments, is now letting you make your own concoctions
summary: Kraft Heinz is recognized as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies of 2024 for its Heinz Remix dispenser, which allows consumers to customize their own sauces. This internet-connected device, rolling out in restaurants like BurgerFi, gathers data on flavor preferences, which Kraft Heinz plans to use for future product development and to inform restaurant partners. The company has already used this agile approach for "sauce drops" inspired by social media trends.

title: Subway to replace Coca-Cola products with Pepsi starting next year
summary: Subway announced a new 10-year partnership with PepsiCo, commencing in January 2025, which will lead to PepsiCo beverages being sold across its U.S. locations. This move ends Subway's nearly two-decade agreement with Coca-Cola. Additionally, Frito-Lay snack products, a PepsiCo subsidiary, will continue to be offered in American restaurants through 2030, streamlining Subway's snack and beverage suppliers.

title: Coke Spiced? Think Twice!
summary: The article reviews Coca-Cola Spiced, a new permanent flavor, from the perspective of a beverage expert. Despite an initial pleasant raspberry taste, the reviewer found a chemical aftertaste that he compared to cheap shampoo, ultimately giving the drink a 4/10 rating. The review also mentions other Coke flavor attempts and highlights the trend of mini soda cans.

title: Princes seals landmark deal to produce Capri-Sun in the UK
summary: Liverpool-based Princes Foods Group has secured a landmark deal with Capri-Sun Group Holding AG to produce over 250m Capri-Sun pouches annually in the UK, creating up to 60 jobs at its Bradford factory. This move follows Capri-Sun bringing sales and production in-house and transitioning four production lines to Princes, with full operation expected by spring 2025. Princes will pack two Capri-Sun formats, and Capri-Sun is also moving towards recyclable pouches and tethered caps to enhance sustainability.

title: Coca-Cola Consolidated pouring additional $50 million into Sandston facility
summary: Coca-Cola Consolidated is investing an additional $50 million to expand its Sandston, Virginia facility, including a new 210,000 square-foot warehouse and 40 new technical jobs. This brings their total investment in the plant over the last three years to $75 million. Company leaders highlighted their commitment to the community and Virginia, and discussed their "Honor God, serve others, pursue excellence, grow profitably" mission.

title: Equifax CEO sees compensation drop in 2023
summary: Equifax CEO Mark Begor's compensation dropped to $13 million in 2023 from $37.2 million in 2022, according to the company's annual proxy statement. Begor, who took the CEO role after a major data breach in 2018, saw a reduction in stock options and other incentives. The article also details the compensation of other Equifax executives and contrasts CEO pay ratios with those of other Atlanta-based companies.

title: Adobe Just Demonstrated How AI Can Create Stellar Marketing Materials for Coca-Cola–or Any Company
summary: Adobe showcased its new GenStudio tool, designed to revolutionize marketing content creation using generative AI. At its recent summit, CEO Shantanu Narayen demonstrated how the tool, through an example with Coca-Cola, can rapidly produce on-brand marketing materials across multiple platforms and analyze their performance to optimize future campaigns. GenStudio is expected to be fully released later this year, promising to significantly speed up content production for marketers.

title: Asur y Kimberly Clark tienen los dividendos más atractivos de la BMV: Valmex
summary: According to a Valmex analysis, Asur and Kimberly Clark offer the most attractive dividends on the Mexican Stock Exchange (BMV), with expected returns of 4.08% and 4.90% respectively. Banorte is also highlighted for having a potential dividend yield of 5.87% if it maintains its policy of distributing 50% of its net profit. The financial, airport, and telecommunications sectors generally provide higher dividend yields due to more predictable cash flows and profitability.

title: Smoothies Market Size & Growth Report [2031]
summary: The global Smoothies Market was valued at USD 8.24 billion in 2023 and is projected to reach USD 16.90 billion by 2031, growing at a CAGR of 9.4%. This growth is driven by increasing consumer demand for convenient and healthy food options, wellness trends, and the influence of social media. Fruit-based smoothies dominated the market in 2023, while Europe held the largest regional market share, and Asia-Pacific is expected to show the highest CAGR.

title: How to Find a Great Dividend Fund
summary: This article provides guidance on how investors can find a great dividend fund by categorizing funds into dividend income, dividend growth, and a combination of both, and discussing their associated risks and trade-offs. Morningstar analysts offer insights into why dividend yield should not be the top priority and compare actively managed funds with passive options, ultimately recommending several passively and actively managed dividend funds.

title: Marvel and Coca-Cola Assemble for an Unprecedented Global Campaign
summary: The Walt Disney Company and Coca-Cola have launched "Coca-Cola x Marvel: The Heroes," an innovative global campaign featuring Marvel characters on limited-edition Coca-Cola packaging, alongside a new TV commercial and an AR experience. The collaboration offers fans a chance to win various Disney and Marvel prizes, enhancing the connection between the two iconic brands. This initiative is available globally in over 50 countries, bringing a new collection experience for Marvel fans.

title: Coca‑Cola® Drops Limited-Edition Packaging and Immersive Storytelling with Characters from Across the Marvel Universe
summary: Coca-Cola and Marvel are launching a new collaboration featuring limited-edition packaging with over 30 Marvel characters. The packaging includes scannable QR codes for Augmented Reality experiences and chances to win prizes. This partnership is supported by a cinematic commercial and began rolling out on April 8th in over 50 countries.

title: The Walt Disney Company Joins Coca-Cola in New Collaboration
summary: The Walt Disney Company and Coca-Cola have launched a new joint venture called 'Coca-Cola x Marvel: The Heroes'. This collaboration features Marvel characters on Coca-Cola packaging, including 38-character illustrations with an AR extension, and offers fans chances to win prizes like a Disney Cruise and movie tickets.

title: The Coca-Cola Company Celebrates Everyday Greatness with Global Program in Advance of Olympic and Paralympic Games in Paris
summary: The Coca-Cola Company announced "Celebrate Everyday Greatness" as its theme for the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games, unveiling its global roster of Team Coca-Cola athletes. The program emphasizes sustainability initiatives, including waste minimization and sustainable product transportation, to enhance the athlete and fan experience. As the longest-running partner of the Olympic Games, Coca-Cola aims to connect with fans through its wide product portfolio and showcase its commitment to inclusivity and environmental responsibility.

title: Team Coca‑Cola's Global Athlete Roster Revealed Ahead of the Olympic and Paralympic Games Paris 2024
summary: The Coca-Cola Company announced its global roster of athletes for "Team Coca-Cola" ahead of the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games. The team comprises diverse athletes who embody "Everyday Greatness," celebrating personal excellence leading to larger victories. These athletes, including Olympians and rising stars, will represent Coca-Cola's longstanding partnership with the Games.

title: The Coca-Cola Company Celebrates Everyday Greatness with Global Program in Advance of Olympic and Paralympic Games in Paris
summary: The Coca-Cola Company has unveiled "Celebrate Everyday Greatness" as its theme for the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games, alongside its global roster of Team Coca-Cola athletes. The program aims to champion life's everyday moments, emphasize sustainability through waste reduction and eco-friendly transport, and connect fans with athletes. Coca-Cola, a long-standing Olympic partner, will provide beverages and implement various activations to enhance the Games experience.

title: Goldman Sachs: Constellation and Molson Coors ‘Big Winners’ for Spring Resets; A-B ‘Doing A Better Job Than Many Expected’
summary: A Goldman Sachs Beverage Bytes beer distributor survey indicates Constellation Brands and Molson Coors are "big winners" for spring shelf resets, with high percentages of distributors expecting them to gain space. Anheuser-Busch InBev is performing better than anticipated in maintaining shelf space, largely due to Michelob Ultra and Busch Light, though its long-term recovery is seen as a "marathon." The survey also highlights trends in the broader beverage alcohol market, including challenges for Boston Beer Company and Heineken, and expected gains for RTDs while hard seltzers and craft beer lose space.

title: Best Licensed Product – Food or Beverage Corp 2024
summary: This article highlights nominees for the "Best Licensed Product – Food or Beverage Corp 2024" award, showcasing innovative collaborations between food/beverage brands and other companies. Featured products include Weber Seasoning Blends inspired by spirits, Tic Tac Sprite, Kraft Heinz branded gummies, Netflix Jumbo Popcorn, and Mentos soft drinks, all demonstrating successful market launches and consumer excitement through licensing deals.

title: Powerade Unveils Olympic Games Experience & Global Campaign for Paris 2024
summary: Powerade has launched a global campaign for the Paris 2024 Olympic Games, featuring Simone Biles and other Team Powerade athletes. The campaign, which includes a new creative spot "The Vault," focuses on supporting athletes' mental and physical well-being through its "Pause is Power" platform. Powerade will also introduce a special Olympic Village experience and a new limited-edition product, Powerade Gold, for the event.

title: The Monster That Turned $1 Into $20,000: Why This Energy Drink Stock Is a Must-Buy
summary: Monster Beverage stock (MNST) has achieved extraordinary returns for long-term investors, turning an initial $1 investment into $20,000 over two decades. The company's success is attributed to its leadership in energy drink production, product innovation, and strategic international expansion, further bolstered by Coca-Cola's investment and distribution partnership. Despite increasing market saturation and competition from rivals like Celsius Holdings, Monster's continued top-line growth and effective cost management position it as a promising long-term investment.

title: Annual Craft Brewing Industry Production Report
summary: The Brewers Association released its annual production report for the U.S. craft brewing industry, showing continued growth in the number of breweries and employment despite a slight decline in overall production volume. The report highlights that the total number of operating craft breweries reached an all-time high of 9,761 in 2023, directly employing 191,421 people. It also identified the top 50 producing craft brewing companies and overall brewing companies for the year.

title: Governor Hochul and the Coca-Cola Company Celebrate Groundbreaking of New fairlife® Production Facility in Monroe County – The Largest Dairy Production Facility in the Northeast | Empire State Development
summary: Governor Kathy Hochul and The Coca-Cola Company have broken ground on a new $650 million fairlife production facility in Webster, Monroe County, set to create approximately 250 jobs and become the largest dairy production facility in the Northeast. New York State is providing $21 million in assistance and nearly 8.5 MW of low-cost power, with Governor Hochul also announcing $20 million in state support for wastewater treatment plant upgrades in the Town of Webster. This investment reinforces New York's position as a leader in agribusiness and contributes to the "Finger Lakes Forward" revitalization strategy.

title: Sprite Reimagines Legendary Obey Your Thirst Campaign with Modern Icons Anthony Edwards and Sha’Carri Richardson
summary: Sprite is reviving its iconic "Obey Your Thirst" campaign, which originally championed individuality through basketball and hip-hop culture. The updated campaign features rising NBA star Anthony Edwards and world-renowned sprinter Sha’Carri Richardson, focusing on their authenticity and determination. The initiative includes new films, limited-edition packaging with QR codes for digital experiences, and sponsorship of the Minnesota Timberwolves' playoff rounds.

title: The Coca‑Cola Company Breaks Ground on New fairlife Production Facility in Webster, NY
summary: The Coca-Cola Company and fairlife have broken ground on a new state-of-the-art fairlife production facility in Webster, New York. This $650 million investment will create approximately 250 jobs and serve as fairlife's flagship Northeast location, processing five to six million pounds of milk daily from local dairy farmers. The facility, designed with sustainability in mind, is anticipated to be operational in Q4 2025.

title: Why Ambev SA (ABEV) Stock Is A Buy? Acquirer’s Multiple Stock Screener Analysis
summary: This article analyzes Ambev SA (ABEV) stock as a potential "buy" based on key financial fundamentals from The Acquirer's Multiple stock screener. It highlights Ambev's position as the largest brewer in Latin America and the Caribbean, its subsidiary relationship with Anheuser-Busch InBev, and its significant market presence. The analysis presents several key financial metrics, including a market cap of $37.01 Billion, an Acquirer’s Multiple of 10.10, and a FCF/EV Yield of 10.12%, suggesting the stock is undervalued despite an 18.90% decline over the past year.

title: Aboitiz Group bullish in 2024
summary: The Aboitiz Group is optimistic about 2024, expecting positive growth through the integration of recent acquisitions like Citi's consumer business, Mactan Airport, and Coca-Cola Beverages Philippines Inc. The conglomerate plans to more than double its capital expenditures to P153 billion this year for further expansions and enhancements across its various businesses. Despite a slight dip in attributable net income in 2023, the group's core net income and revenues saw an increase.

title: The Coca-Cola Company and Microsoft announce five-year strategic partnership to accelerate cloud and generative AI initiatives
summary: The Coca-Cola Company and Microsoft have announced a five-year strategic partnership, with Coca-Cola committing $1.1 billion to the Microsoft Cloud and its generative AI capabilities. This collaboration aims to accelerate cloud adoption, foster innovation, and improve productivity across Coca-Cola's global operations. The company has already migrated all applications to Microsoft Azure and is exploring generative AI-powered digital assistants to enhance customer experiences and streamline operations.

title: Coca-Cola pours $1.1B into Microsoft cloud, generative AI partnership
summary: The Coca-Cola Company is expanding its partnership with Microsoft, investing $1.1 billion into the tech giant's cloud and generative AI services. This move will involve testing Azure OpenAI Service and Copilot for Microsoft 365 across various business functions to enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and identify growth opportunities. Coca-Cola was reportedly an early adopter of generative AI, having already gained nearly a year of experience with ChatGPT Enterprise in its workflows.

title: The Coca-Cola Company announces 5-year AI partnership with Microsoft
summary: The Coca-Cola Company has announced a five-year AI partnership with Microsoft, committing $1.1 billion to Microsoft Cloud and its generative AI capabilities. This collaboration aims to integrate AI across Coca-Cola's core systems to enhance efficiency, scalability, customer experiences, marketing, and supply chain operations. The partnership builds on a previous agreement and will see Coca-Cola leveraging solutions like Azure OpenAI Service and Copilot to drive digital transformation.

title: Fanta Nudges Fans to Do More of What They ‘Wanta’
summary: Fanta is re-launching its iconic "Wanta Fanta" platform to encourage Gen Z to balance their responsibilities with their desires, emphasizing guilt-free indulgence. The multi-year campaign includes digital content, influencer partnerships, shopper activations, and a remake of the classic jingle. The initiative aims to resonate with Gen Z's global struggle to find fun and enjoyment amidst daily pressures.

title: Coca-Cola is largest known contributor of branded plastic waste, global study finds
summary: A new global study has identified The Coca-Cola Company as the largest known contributor of branded plastic waste, with 56 brands, including Coca-Cola, responsible for over half of the plastic pollution worldwide. The study found a strong link between companies' plastic production and pollution, with food and beverage companies being disproportionately large polluters. Coca-Cola aims to make its packaging 100% recyclable by 2025 and use 50% recycled material by 2030, while researchers emphasize the need to phase out single-use plastics from major polluters.

title: Fanta Says, 'Do More of What You Wanta' With New Global Campaign
summary: Fanta is launching a new global campaign titled "Do More of What You Wanta," a modern reprise of its iconic "Wanta Fanta" platform. The campaign encourages consumers, particularly Gen Z, to prioritize their desires and wants amidst daily pressures, positioning Fanta as an easy way to achieve these moments. It will feature a remixed anthem, TikTok creator engagement, out-of-home advertising, and an interactive "Wanta Mobile" truck experience.

title: The Coca Cola Co. 2024 guidance upped
summary: The Coca-Cola Co. has raised its long-term guidance for several key reporting measures, leading to a rise in its shares. The company is reportedly also considering listing its South Africa bottling business again, amidst "intense" inflationary pressures.

title: Nik Jhangiani to join Diageo as Chief Financial Officer
summary: Diageo announced that Nik Jhangiani will join the company as Chief Financial Officer in Autumn 2024, replacing Lavanya Chandrashekar. Jhangiani brings over 30 years of finance experience, primarily within the consumer and beverage industries, most recently as CFO of Coca-Cola Europacific Partners. Lavanya Chandrashekar is stepping down after three years as CFO, having significantly contributed to Diageo's growth, productivity savings, and increased long-term investment.

title: Diageo Plc appoints Nik Jhangiani as new CFO, Lavanya Chandrashekar steps down
summary: Diageo Plc has appointed Nik Jhangiani, currently CFO of Coca-Cola Europacific Partners, as its new Chief Financial Officer, replacing Lavanya Chandrashekar. Jhangiani will join Diageo's Board and Executive Committee in Autumn 2024. Chandrashekar is stepping down after three years in the role to return to the US, following a period where Diageo faced a slowdown in the US market and issued a profit warning.

title: Diageo to welcome Coca Cola’s Nik Jhangiani as CFO
summary: Diageo is appointing Nik Jhangiani, currently CFO at Coca-Cola Europacific Partners, as its new chief financial officer starting autumn this year. Jhangiani has over 30 years of finance experience, including 20 years as a CFO in the consumer and beverage industries. He will replace Lavanya Chandrashekar, who is returning to the US after a successful three-year tenure at Diageo.

title: Coca-Cola Beverages Florida Recognized as a US Best Managed Company, Third Consecutive Year
summary: Coca-Cola Beverages Florida (Coke Florida) has been recognized as a US Best Managed Company for the third consecutive year by Deloitte* Private and The Wall Street Journal. This award acknowledges the achievements and successful management teams of U.S. private companies, evaluated across four key areas: strategy, execution, culture, and governance/financial performance. Coke Florida emphasizes its commitment to associates, customers, and community investment as core reasons for this repeated recognition.

title: Coca-Cola consolidated completes $553.7M stock buyback
summary: Coca-Cola Consolidated, Inc. has completed a $553.7 million stock buyback, repurchasing 598,619 shares from Carolina Coca-Cola Bottling Investments, Inc. for $925 per share. This transaction is part of the company's strategy to manage its capital structure and return value to shareholders. The company also recently terminated $1.3 billion in term loan facilities and declared a quarterly dividend of $0.50 per share.

title: Carlos Pagoaga to be Named President of The Coca-Cola Foundation
summary: Carlos Pagoaga, a 34-year veteran of The Coca-Cola Company, will be named Vice President of Global Community Affairs and President of The Coca-Cola Foundation, effective June 1. He succeeds Saadia Madsbjerg and will manage all Foundation operations, including grantmaking and regulatory compliance. Pagoaga's appointment is pending formal election by the Foundation board and he will report to Bea Perez, Executive Vice President and Global Chief Communications, Sustainability & Strategic Partnerships Officer.

title: The Coca-Cola Company is always innovating and exploring the future of best-in-class brands and experiences
summary: The Coca-Cola Company is committed to continuous innovation across its business, from beverages and marketing to operational processes and sustainability. The company prioritizes consumers by focusing on strategic, data-driven experimentation and agility, introducing new products, expanding into new categories like alcohol ready-to-drink, and transforming marketing through AI and digital technologies. Coca-Cola also emphasizes sustainability by exploring new technologies to reduce waste and carbon emissions while improving water and energy use.

title: Coca-Cola HBC: Circularity at the Heart of Sustainability
summary: Coca-Cola HBC aims to achieve a net-zero carbon footprint and net positive biodiversity by 2040, with circularity being essential to plastic reduction. Marcel Martin, Chief Corporate Affairs and Sustainability Officer, highlights the company's strong focus on packaging sustainability, aiming for 100% recyclable consumer packaging and significant use of recycled PET by Mission 2025. The company is investing in Deposit Return Schemes in Europe and collection centers in Africa to give plastic a new life.

title: New Platform Offers Retail and Restaurant Partners Data-Backed Insights and Industry Trends Through a Uniquely Coca-Cola Lens
summary: Coca-Cola has launched "Coca-Cola Lens," a new platform designed to provide retail and restaurant partners with data-backed insights and industry trends. The platform offers a library of thought leadership articles from Coca-Cola's internal experts, supplemented by proprietary and third-party data, to help businesses grow and thrive. It will offer revenue-driving guidance and timely topics, with new articles added quarterly.

title: Here’s Why Coca-Cola Consolidated Will Likely Announce a Stock Split in 2024
summary: Coca-Cola Consolidated (NASDAQ: COKE), the largest single Coca-Cola bottler, is likely to announce a forward stock split in 2024 due to its high stock price, strong financial metrics, and a recent $3.1 billion stock buyback that reduces The Coca-Cola Company's stake. The company's stock, currently trading over $950 per share, hasn't split since 1984, making it less accessible for individual investors. A 4-for-1 split would bring the price down to a more affordable under $250 per share, enhancing liquidity and investor accessibility.

title: Coca-Cola Co. Debuts New Proprietary Insights Platform
summary: The Coca-Cola Co. has launched Coca-Cola Lens, a new insights platform designed to assist foodservice and retail operators in making data-driven decisions. This platform will help track relevant consumer preference trends, leveraging Coca-Cola's extensive market presence to provide real-time insights through a user-friendly website. It will debut at the 2024 National Restaurant Association Show, offering thought leadership stories on various topics.

title: Coca-Cola Moving Closer to $338 Million Birmingham Campus
summary: Coca-Cola United is moving forward with plans for a new $338 million campus in Birmingham where the former Stockham Valve property was located. The campus will include a sales, distribution, warehousing center, offices, and a customer call center, and is anticipated to add 50 new jobs. The City of Birmingham has approved incentives, including $400,000 for infrastructure and sales and ad valorem tax abatements for 10 and 15 years respectively.

title: Ball, Ardagh, Coca-Cola aluminum supplier Novelis pursues IPO
summary: Novelis, an aluminum company supplying major beverage can distributors like Ball and Ardagh, and directly to Coca-Cola's contracting agent, is pursuing an initial public offering (IPO). The company, owned by Hindalco Industries since 2007, generates 47% of its sales from beverage packaging and emphasizes its leadership in aluminum rolling and recycling, with 63% recycled content in its materials for fiscal year 2024 and a target of 75% by 2030. Its filings highlight strong U.S. market demand for beverage cans, driven by diverse beverage types and a complete supply chain inventory reduction.

title: Why Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF Is One of the Best Dividend Funds Available
summary: The Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF (SCHD) is highlighted for its sensible, transparent, and risk-conscious approach, aiming for better long-term risk-adjusted returns than the Russell 1000 Value Index. The fund's strategy focuses on 100 dividend-paying stocks with strong financial health, offering downside protection and strong exposure to the quality factor. Despite a challenging 2023, its overall performance since inception demonstrates strong risk-adjusted and absolute returns within the large-value category.

title: Coca-Cola UNITED Appoints Norman H. Ross Jr. '98 as Vice President of Public Affairs and Communications
summary: Coca-Cola Bottling Company United, Inc. (UNITED) has appointed Norman H. Ross Jr. '98 as its new Vice President of Public Affairs and Communications. Ross brings over 25 years of experience to the role, succeeding Linda Sewell, who is retiring after more than 40 years. He will be responsible for the strategic direction of public affairs, government relations, communications, community engagement, and charitable giving for Coca-Cola UNITED.

title: Governor Ivey Announces Coca-Cola United to Invest $330 Million in New Facility, Creating 50 Jobs in Birmingham
summary: Governor Kay Ivey announced that Coca-Cola Bottling Company United Inc. (UNITED) plans to invest $330 million to construct a new facility in Birmingham, creating 50 new jobs and retaining over 750 positions. This investment marks a significant expansion for the company, which has been part of Birmingham's business community for over 120 years. The new facility will include a large office complex and a state-of-the-art warehouse, and it is expected to have a lasting positive impact on Birmingham's economy and community.

title: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners sells Feral Brewing Co.
summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP) has sold its Australian producer Feral Brewing Co. to a joint venture involving Nail Brewing and an undisclosed consortium of investors. This move allows CCEP to focus on its core non-alcoholic ready-to-drink (NARTD) products. Feral Brewing's production assets have been sold to Beerfarm, which will continue to produce Feral-branded products.

title: Coca-Cola Bottling Company United To Invest $330M In New Alabama Facility
summary: Coca-Cola Bottling Company United is investing $330 million in a new state-of-the-art facility in Birmingham, Alabama, creating up to 50 new jobs and retaining over 750 existing positions. The new complex, located on the former Stockham Valves and Fittings site, will include a multi-floor office complex and a large warehouse with advanced order fulfillment technology. This investment signifies the company's continued commitment to the Birmingham community and its future growth.

title: Costa Coffee Expands Iced Coffee Latte Line in U.S. This Summer
summary: Costa Coffee is expanding its iced coffee latte line nationwide in the U.S. this summer, offering Mocha, Caramel, and Signature Blend flavors with real cane sugar and 100% Arabica beans. To promote this launch, Costa Coffee is partnering with Y7 Studio to offer "Sip and Flow" yoga experiences, including free digital memberships and in-studio classes in select cities, along with free Costa Iced Coffee Lattes. The new line, developed by The Coca-Cola Company, aims to invigorate the coffee category and cater to active lifestyles, with products available at major retailers across the country.

title: Restaurant Brands International Inc. Appoints Patrick Siewert as Senior Advisor in Asia-Pacific Region
summary: Restaurant Brands International Inc. has appointed Patrick Siewert as its Senior Advisor in the Asia-Pacific region to help drive growth and expansion. Siewert brings extensive experience in food, beverage, and consumer products in Asia, including 16 years with the Carlyle Group and a prior role as COO for Coca-Cola in Asia. His appointment supports RBI's goal of opening 7,000 new international restaurants by 2028, particularly enhancing master franchise partnerships and talent acquisition in the APAC region.

title: Beyond the Game: The Coca-Cola Company Helps Boys & Girls Club Teens Score Big in the Business of Sports at the 2024 NCAA Final Fours
summary: The Coca-Cola Company partnered with Boys & Girls Clubs of America to provide teens with a hands-on sports marketing experience at the 2024 NCAA Women's Final Four. Teens from Boys & Girls Clubs of Northeast Ohio gained insights into careers in sports business, participated in a virtual learning session with industry experts, and even saw their own in-game entertainment idea come to life during the championship practice. This initiative highlights the diverse career opportunities within the sports industry beyond being an athlete and reinforces Coca-Cola's long-standing partnership with the Boys & Girls Clubs.

title: Why Investing Guru Jeremy Grantham’s New ETF Shuns Nvidia and Tesla Stock
summary: Legendary investor Jeremy Grantham's new ETF, GMO’s U.S. Quality ETF, is outperforming the stock market despite intentionally excluding high-momentum stocks like Nvidia and Tesla. The ETF instead focuses on defensive stocks such as Coca-Cola, alongside five of the "Magnificent Seven" tech stocks. This strategy highlights a preference for quality and value over pure momentum plays.

title: Why Investing Guru Jeremy Grantham’s New ETF Shuns Nvidia and Tesla Stock
summary: Legendary value investor Jeremy Grantham's new GMO’s U.S. Quality ETF is outperforming the stock market despite shunning high-momentum stocks like Nvidia and Tesla. The ETF opts for more defensive stocks such as Coca-Cola, while still holding five of the "Magnificent Seven" tech stocks. This strategy highlights a focus on quality and value over pure momentum plays.

title: Keurig Dr Pepper Expands DSD Operations With Kalil Bottling Acquisition
summary: Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) is expanding its direct-store delivery (DSD) reach through the acquisition of Kalil Bottling Co. and its Arizona operations. This strategic move aims to strengthen national DSD capabilities, enhance scale, and build brands in a fast-growing beverage market, adding approximately 425 employees and extending KDP's system reach and local consumer insights. The acquisition is part of KDP's broader strategy to consolidate distribution and optimize its route to market for its portfolio of leading brands.

title: Food co-ops aren't known for price-conscious customers. That's changing
summary: Natural food co-ops are traditionally known for organic and fair-trade products, but are now shifting focus towards affordability due to changing consumer values and economic pressures. This includes increasing offerings of cheaper organic brands and even conventional products like Coca-Cola. This strategic move aims to attract a broader customer base and has led to a rise in sales for many co-ops.

title: Quality Assurance at Coca Cola with CO2 Purity Monitoring
summary: This article highlights how Coca-Cola Beverages Northeast utilizes the Thermo Scientific MAX-Bev system for CO2 purity monitoring. Sarah Heald, Quality Supervisor, explains the system's role in ensuring beverage-grade CO2 purity, reducing human error, and significantly streamlining the quality control process. The MAX-Bev system allows for accurate and precise testing, crucial for maintaining product taste and meeting industry standards, ultimately contributing to "the perfect sip" for consumers.

title: Clorox Is Accelerating Innovation With Generative AI Investment
summary: Clorox is accelerating its innovation strategy by investing in a generative AI tool to identify global trends and rapidly develop digital prototypes. This initiative is part of the company's digital transformation following a cyber attack and aims to enhance customer relationships and operational efficiency. The first AI-driven innovation launched in 90 days, significantly faster than previous timelines.

title: Coca-Cola ad in Bangladesh sparks backlash for ‘denying ties with Israel’
summary: A Coca-Cola advertisement in Bangladesh has caused significant backlash for attempting to distance the brand from Israel amidst the war in Gaza and a widespread boycott. The commercial, which claims Coca-Cola is not an Israeli product and mentions a Coke factory in "Palestine," has been criticized for insensitivity and factual inaccuracies, as the factory is located in an Israeli settlement in the occupied West Bank. Despite being briefly withdrawn, the ad reappeared with comments disabled, failing to curb public outrage and boycott efforts.

title: Spin-off da UFMG é adquirida pelo Grupo Bradesco
summary: The UFMG spin-off Kunumi, co-founded by professor Nívio Ziviani and CEO Alberto Colares, has been acquired by Bradesco Holding de Investimentos S.A. Kunumi, established in 2016, specializes in artificial intelligence, developing a platform that mimics brain function to analyze large datasets and solve complex problems. This acquisition highlights an innovative legal model where UFMG, as a co-founder, benefits from the company's success through an usufruct of shares agreement.

title: Coca-Cola United celebrates start of $330 million Alabama growth project
summary: Coca-Cola Bottling Company United Inc. has begun a $330 million growth project in Birmingham, Alabama, marking an investment that will create 50 new jobs and retain 750 existing ones. The new facility, located in the Kingston community, will house various Coca-Cola operations and act as a gateway to the city. Gov. Kay Ivey and company leadership celebrated the project, emphasizing Coca-Cola United's long-standing commitment to Alabama.

title: Coca-Cola operates in Russia despite exit claims, PepsiCo adds new factory
summary: Despite official claims of exiting the Russian market, Coca-Cola products remain widely available in Russia, with its subsidiary Coca-Cola HBC continuing to profit and even increase market share through the "Dobry Cola" brand. Simultaneously, PepsiCo is expanding its business in Russia, having opened a new snack factory in April, despite previously announcing a cessation of investments and sales. These actions have drawn criticism, with advocacy groups like the Ukrainian Congress Committee of America urging global corporations to fully withdraw from the Russian market.

title: PepsiCo anticipates missing certain 2025 packaging sustainability goals
summary: PepsiCo has stated in its 2023 ESG report that it expects to miss some of its 2025 packaging sustainability goals, including the target to design 100% of its packaging to be recyclable, compostable, biodegradable, or reusable. The company projects reaching 98% by 2025 for this goal and also reported a 6% increase in virgin plastic use, despite aiming for a 20% reduction by 2030. Despite the shortfalls, PepsiCo highlighted progress in areas like switching to fiber carriers for beverage multipacks and increasing recycled PET content in some products.

title: Governor Gianforte Welcomes $100 Million Coca-Cola High Country Investment in Montana
summary: Governor Greg Gianforte celebrated the opening of a new $100 million Coca-Cola High Country facility in Billings, Montana, which will create over 100 jobs. This investment marks Coca-Cola High Country's largest facility in the state and supports manufacturing, sales, and distribution across the region. The move highlights the Gianforte administration's efforts to attract job-creating businesses to Montana through tax code reforms and fostering a pro-business environment.

title: The Coca-Cola Company Launches Olympic and Paralympic Games Campaign for North America Featuring Versatile Roster of Athletes and Brands
summary: The Coca-Cola Company has launched its Olympic and Paralympic Games campaign for North America, featuring a diverse roster of Team USA and Team Canada athletes. The campaign builds on the global theme "Celebrate Everyday Greatness" and includes new commercials, digital experiences with prize opportunities via QR codes on packaging, and media partnerships. It highlights several Coca-Cola brands and athletes such as Alex Morgan, Simone Biles, and Katie Ledecky, celebrating Coca-Cola's long-standing partnership with the Olympic Games.

title: Emporia Coca-Cola transitions to new ownership
summary: The Emporia Coca-Cola Bottling Company, a long-standing local business, has been acquired by Heartland Coca-Cola Bottling Company. This sale marks the end of the DeBauge family's extensive involvement in the local beverage industry. Heartland Coca-Cola, led by former NBA professional Junior Bridgeman, acquires Emporia Coca-Cola and Classic Vending as part of its strategic expansion in the Midwest.

title: The Coca-Cola Company Announces Timing of Second Quarter 2024 Earnings Release
summary: The Coca-Cola Company announced it will release its second quarter 2024 financial results on July 23 before the New York Stock Exchange opens. An investor conference call will follow at 8:30 a.m. ET to discuss the results, with a webcast available for investors. Downloadable files and a transcript will be provided on the company's website after the call.

title: Coca-Cola and POWERADE Kick Off New Worldwide Partnership with CONMEBOL For Copa América 2024™
summary: Coca-Cola and POWERADE have announced a new worldwide partnership with CONMEBOL for Copa América 2024™, building on Coca-Cola's extensive legacy in global football. This sponsorship provides both brands with significant visibility across digital, in-venue, and TV platforms throughout the tournament. The collaboration aims to deepen fan connection and promote the sport's positive values, especially in Latin America where football is deeply embedded in culture.

title: A Historic Collaboration: Special Olympics and The Coca-Cola Company Extend Global Partnership Through 2031
summary: Special Olympics and The Coca-Cola Company announced an eight-year extension of their global partnership through 2031, marking the longest renewal in their 56-year history. Coca-Cola, a founding partner since 1968, supports Special Olympics programs, athletes, and events worldwide through monetary and in-kind donations, volunteer efforts, and marketing initiatives. This renewed collaboration emphasizes their shared commitment to championing inclusion and showcasing the potential of individuals with intellectual disabilities through the unifying power of sport.

title: Keurig Dr Pepper reports goal progress, lower PCR share
summary: Keurig Dr Pepper made progress towards most of its 2025 plastic-use targets, with overall plastic packaging down 5% year over year. While the share of PCR in plastic packaging decreased to 17% in 2023 from 18% in 2022, the company reduced virgin plastic use by 15% and has 95% recyclable or compostable packaging. The company faces ongoing challenges like inconsistent recycling infrastructure and varying state policies as it works to meet its goals.

title: How Did Dr Pepper Catch Up to Pepsi?
summary: Dr Pepper has recently tied Pepsi as the second-most-popular soda in the U.S. by sales volume, a remarkable achievement given its long history as a niche drink. This success is attributed to its unique "sweet and spicy" flavor, a landmark 1960s lawsuit allowing it on both Coke and Pepsi soda fountains, innovative marketing campaigns targeting younger generations, and recent expansions into new flavors and digital advertising. Pepsi's declining market share and strategic shift towards sugar-free options and energy drinks also contributed to Dr Pepper's ascendance.

title: PepsiCo, Coca-Cola sued by Baltimore for cleanup costs
summary: The City of Baltimore has sued PepsiCo, Coca-Cola, and other companies to recover costs associated with plastic pollution cleanup. The lawsuit alleges false claims, design defects, and deceptive practices by the companies, which Baltimore states have increased plastic production while externalizing cleanup costs. This marks PepsiCo's second plastics-related lawsuit in less than a year.

title: Keurig Dr Pepper: Selling Calls Can Yield 7% With Room For Upside (NASDAQ:KDP)
summary: The article highlights Keurig Dr Pepper's strong market share gains, particularly Dr Pepper surpassing Pepsi, and its rapid top and bottom-line growth since 2018. It suggests that KDP shares are attractively valued and recommends a covered call position to potentially yield 16% over a year with minimal risk, rating KDP as a 'Buy'.

title: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners chooses Systal Technology Solutions for network transformation
summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP) has partnered with Systal Technology Solutions for a network transformation across Europe, involving support for over 6,500 devices in 300 locations across 11 countries. This expanded partnership builds on a six-year relationship and aims to enhance CCEP's operational efficiency and ensure business continuity. Separately, CCEP part-owner The Coca-Cola Company recently signed a significant cloud and AI services contract with Microsoft.

title: ‘It’s Magic When the World Comes Together’: Olympic Athletes and Fans Alike Embrace in Global Coca-Cola Campaign for Paris 2024
summary: Coca-Cola has launched a new global campaign for the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games, centered around the theme "it’s magic when the world comes together." The multi-channel campaign, which includes a powerful brand film and distinctive can designs, uses the gesture of a hug to symbolize unity, inclusion, and the power of sport to foster connections. Coca-Cola aims to refresh athletes, officials, and fans as a Worldwide Partner of the Games and Presenting Partner of the Paris 2024 Olympic Torch Relay.

title: Podcast: How is Kraft Heinz Preparing for the Future of Food?
summary: This article discusses how Kraft Heinz is adapting to changing consumer tastes and emerging technologies by interviewing Robert Scott, President of R&D for North America. Scott details partnerships like with NotCo, the integration of AI into product development, and innovations like the Heinz Remix machine and 360Crisp technology. The piece highlights Kraft Heinz's efforts to transform its product lineup to meet evolving market demands.

title: SA gas users plan venture to secure supply before 2026
summary: South Africa's industrial gas users are forming a joint venture to secure gas supply after Sasol announced it would halt supply from Mozambique in 2026. The Industrial Gas Users Association of Southern Africa (IGUA-SA) is spearheading this effort, planning an externally funded, private company based on a cost-pass-through model. This initiative aims to avert a major crisis that could jeopardize hundreds of thousands of jobs and force industrial users to switch to more expensive and environmentally damaging fuels.

title: C-Store People News for July 2024
summary: This article details significant personnel changes across the convenience-store industry in July 2024, including new hires, promotions, and retirements at retailers, suppliers, and associations. Key appointments include Maryann Mannen as CEO of Marathon Petroleum Corp., Nate Brazier as President and CEO of Stinker Stores, and Caitlyn Carr as President and CEO of Coca-Cola Bottlers’ Sales & Services Co. The article highlights the ongoing evolution within the industry and its leadership.

title: The Fascinating Evolution of Coca-Cola: From Cocaine Tonic to Tech-Savvy Giant
summary: This article details the historical evolution of Coca-Cola, starting from its origins in 1886 as a tonic containing coca leaf extract, which included cocaine. It describes how the company transitioned away from cocaine by 1904, though it continues to use decocainized coca leaves for flavoring, with the extracted cocaine sold to pharmaceutical companies. The article also highlights Coca-Cola's modern initiatives, including sustainable coca farming and a strategic partnership with Microsoft for digital transformation.

title: Jack Daniel’s® and Coca‑Cola ARTD Debuts in South Africa
summary: Brown-Forman Corporation and The Coca-Cola Company have launched the Jack Daniel’s and Coca-Cola Alcoholic Ready-To-Drink (ARTD) spirit cooler in South Africa, following its success in over 25 global markets. This new offering, available in original and Zero Sugar variants, combines Jack Daniel’s Tennessee Whiskey with Coca-Cola in a convenient 300 ml slim can with 5% ABV. The companies emphasize responsible drinking and will implement a phased rollout in select liquor stores.

title: The history of and ties Coca-Cola has to Columbia
summary: This article explores the historical connections between Coca-Cola and Columbia, SC, explaining how the city earned its "Soda City" nickname due to the bottling company's presence. It highlights the former location of the Columbia Coca-Cola Bottling Company and mentions that Coca-Cola Bottling Company Consolidated is now located in Blythewood. A notable historical anecdote includes Michael Jordan judging a Coca-Cola-sponsored slam dunk contest in Columbia in 1988, won by former Gamecock Stephen "Jo Jo" English.

title: Alta demanda provoca desabasto de algunos productos de Coca-Cola
summary: Coca-Cola FEMSA confirmed a shortage of some of its products in Mexico due to exceptionally high demand, especially during a period of high temperatures in May. This surge in demand has led the company to prioritize the production of its most profitable product, Coca-Cola, over other flavored soft drinks, impacting availability and leading to price increases. Despite health warnings, Coca-Cola remains deeply ingrained in Mexican family culture, with Chiapas showing the highest consumption rates.

title: WPP brings back data hotshot Brian Lesser to lead GroupM
summary: WPP has appointed Brian Lesser as Global CEO of GroupM, its media investment arm. Lesser, who previously held a CEO role at GroupM North America and Infosum, is known for his expertise in data and technology-driven marketing. He replaces Christian Juhl, who will transition to president of corporate development within WPP.

title: Esta es la razón por la que hay desabasto de productos Coca Cola en México
summary: FEMSA has acknowledged a shortage of some Coca-Cola products in Mexico because the high demand has exceeded its production capacity. Despite record production levels, the company is struggling to meet demand, especially for non-Coca-Cola flavored beverages, leading them to prioritize the traditional Coca-Cola. To address this, FEMSA is adding two new production lines and has relocated another to the southeastern region to boost capacity.

title: Coca-Cola raises full-year sales guidance after stronger-than-expected second quarter
summary: Coca-Cola has raised its full-year sales guidance after a stronger-than-expected second quarter, driven by continued price increases. The company anticipates organic sales to grow between 9% and 10% this year, up from previous projections. Revenue for the April-June period rose 3% to $12.4 billion, surpassing Wall Street expectations, despite signs of softening demand among lower-income consumers due to price hikes.

title: Coca-Cola boosts full-year outlook thanks to higher prices
summary: Coca-Cola has raised its full-year outlook due to strong performance in the second quarter, primarily driven by higher pricing. The company's strategy of increasing prices has positively impacted its financial projections for the year.

title: Coca-Cola raises forecasts, bets on price hikes and ad blitz
summary: Coca-Cola has increased its annual sales and profit forecasts, expecting to benefit from strategic price hikes and an extensive advertising campaign, particularly in international markets where demand remains robust. The company's shares rose nearly 2% after it reported a surprising increase in second-quarter revenue. This strategy includes marketing new products and sponsoring major global events to appeal to a younger demographic, while also promoting budget-friendly options.

title: Coca-Cola leverages AI, technology to drive sales, volume in difficult economic climate
summary: Coca-Cola is using AI and digital technologies like its Studio X to boost sales and volumes, particularly for new products, in a challenging economic environment. The company exceeded Q2 expectations with a 3% revenue growth to $12.4 billion, despite a global average price increase of 9%, by enhancing marketing, innovation, and price-pack architecture through technology, including AI-driven personalized messaging to retailers. This strategy contrasts with its rival PepsiCo, which reported lower-than-expected revenue due to volume declines.

title: Hello World: The Coca-Cola Company Teams Up with the International Olympic Committee to Debut All-New Soundtrack of the Olympic Games Featuring Global Music Superstars
summary: The Coca-Cola Company has partnered with the International Olympic Committee to release an all-new soundtrack for the Olympic Games, titled "Hello World (Song of the Olympics TM )." Created by Ryan Tedder and performed by Gwen Stefani and Anderson .Paak, the song aims to celebrate togetherness, positivity, and the spirit of the Olympic and Paralympic Games Paris 2024. The collaboration marks a significant moment in Coca-Cola's 96-year relationship with the Olympic movement, with the song set to debut on July 25th alongside a music video.

title: Keurig Dr Pepper earnings meet estimates as higher prices fuel U.S. soda sales
summary: Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) reported Q2 2024 earnings and revenue that met Wall Street expectations, driven by higher prices in its U.S. refreshment beverages division. The company's U.S. coffee division saw sales decline, while its international division experienced strong growth. KDP reiterated its full-year financial outlook.

title: Coca-Cola Southwest Beverages prioritizes company culture and employee engagement
summary: Coca-Cola Southwest Beverages (CCSWB) prioritizes company culture and employee engagement through its Market Investment Days (MIDs) program. This initiative involves executive and office-based teams visiting frontline staff to gather feedback and foster transparency, communication, and trust, leading to significant improvements and doubled sales since 2017. The program also led to the revival of the annual "truck rodeo" and system-wide adoption of effective practices, reinforcing CCSWB's commitment to its employees and community.

title: Mondelēz International taps Nestlé, P&G veteran as tech chief
summary: Mondelēz International has appointed Filippo Catalano as its new chief information and digital officer. Catalano, who previously held senior technology roles at Nestlé, Reckitt, and Procter & Gamble, will report directly to CEO Dirk Van de Put. This appointment reflects a broader trend of companies enhancing their tech leadership, with Catalano tasked with driving digital transformation for the global snack company.

title: Recipe for Magic: WPP and NVIDIA Omniverse Help The Coca-Cola Company Scale Generative AI Content That Pops With Brand Authenticity
summary: WPP and NVIDIA are partnering with The Coca-Cola Company to scale generative AI content for global marketing campaigns. Utilizing NVIDIA Omniverse and NIM microservices, particularly USD Search and USD Code, Coca-Cola can rapidly personalize and localize marketing assets across over 100 markets. This collaboration allows for quicker iteration on creative campaigns and the production of brand-authentic, culturally relevant 3D advertising content.

title: Mexico, Canada and beyond: Keurig Dr Pepper’s international growth strategy
summary: Keurig Dr Pepper is focusing on Mexico and Canada as key markets for its international growth strategy, driven by a "buy, build and partner model." The company reported a 15% increase in international sales in the latest quarter, with a strong performance in both Latin American and Canadian markets, and plans to expand into new areas like low and no-alcohol beverages. KDP sees its international portfolio, currently representing about $2 billion in sales annually, as an increasingly significant growth driver.

title: Embotelladora Andina duplica sus ganancias en el segundo trimestre
summary: Embotelladora Andina reported a significant increase in its second-quarter profits, attributing the growth to strong operational results and the absence of a non-operational loss recorded in 2023. The company's attributed profits reached $24.601 million (US$26 million), doubling the previous year's figures for the same period. This growth was driven by increased income in Brazil and Paraguay, although sales in Argentina and Chile saw a reduction.

title: Ganancias. Coca-Cola Andina aumentó sus beneficios casi 77%
summary: Coca-Cola Andina, an embottler for Coca-Cola products in South America, reported a 76.8% increase in net profits during the first half of the year, reaching over U$S 93 million. Consolidated net sales rose by 12% to over U$S 1.5 billion, although sales in Argentina decreased by 19.5%, marking it as the only market with negative growth. The company's adjusted EBITDA grew by 18.5%, driven by increased sales volumes in Brazil and Paraguay and higher sugar prices, despite a decrease in sales in Argentina.

title: Coca-Cola Consolidated Partners with ISN to Improve Contractor Safety and Compliance
summary: Coca-Cola Consolidated, the largest Coca-Cola bottler in the U.S., has selected ISNetworld as its primary contractor management system. This partnership with ISN aims to enhance contractor safety and compliance by assisting with site orientations, compliance reviews, documentation, and insurance. The company plans to implement the system across all manufacturing facilities and integrate compliance requirements within the first year.

title: FANTA® AND WARNER BROS. PICTURES ANNOUNCE GLOBAL PARTNERSHIP WITH THE HIGHLY ANTICIPATED NEW MOVIE BEETLEJUICE BEETLEJUICE WITH LIMITED-EDITION FLAVOUR
summary: Fanta and Warner Bros. Pictures have announced a global partnership to celebrate the release of the new movie Beetlejuice Beetlejuice, debuting in cinemas on September 6, 2024. This collaboration includes a limited-edition Fanta Beetlejuice flavor, character-themed packaging for the full Fanta range, and exclusive physical and digital experiences accessible via QR codes. The partnership aims to encourage consumers to "Summon What You Wanta" this Halloween season with unique activations throughout September and October.

title: Investors - Governance - Board of Directors - Person Details
summary: This page introduces Keith Credendino as the Chief Information Officer of Macy's, Inc., a role he assumed in August 2024. It details his responsibilities, which include overseeing information technology applications, infrastructure, and operations that support Macy's' data-first modernization strategy. The article also highlights his previous experience at Macy's as Senior Vice President, Technology Product Development, Customer Experience, and prior roles at Inspire Brands, The Home Depot, InterContinental Hotels Group, and Cox Enterprises, emphasizing his expertise in large-scale e-commerce, loyalty systems, and cloud-native infrastructure.

title: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners invests $105.5m in Australian manufacturing
summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP) is investing $105.5 million to expand its manufacturing capabilities in Australia, funding a new Warmfill Line at its Moorabbin plant in Victoria. This investment will boost the production of Powerade and Fuze Tea, addressing rising demand for sports drinks and no-sugar variants. The project, including a new 4,200m² manufacturing hall and high-speed production line, is expected to reduce transportation by 2.9 million kilometers annually and will be operational by Q1 2026.

title: vitaminwater® Introduces Paint Your Rent: A Chance to Transform Your Living Space in Full vitaminwater Color This Summer
summary: vitaminwater is launching its "Paint Your Rent" campaign, inviting fans to creatively incorporate vitaminwater colors and flavors into their living spaces for a chance to win free rent for a year and custom design services from Havenly. The campaign aims to bring vibrancy into homes, offering five winners custom design inspiration and a color-coordinated mini-fridge stocked with vitaminwater flavors. Mood boards created with Havenly's lead designer, Kelsey Fischer, showcase how different vitaminwater flavors can inspire unique interior design aesthetics.

title: Coca-Cola and the OREO Brand are Teaming Up: ‘Besties’ Around the World Can Savor New Limited-Edition Drink and Cookie
summary: Coca-Cola and OREO are collaborating to release limited-edition products: Coca-Cola OREO Zero Sugar and OREO Coca-Cola Sandwich Cookies. This partnership is part of Coca-Cola Creations, aiming to offer unique flavor experiences and immersive digital and physical activities for fans, especially targeting Gen Z. The new products will be available in 35 markets worldwide starting in September.

title: Daniel Peris: The Case for Dividend Investing
summary: Daniel Peris, a portfolio manager at Federated Hermes and author of "The Ownership Dividend," discusses the historical importance of dividends and argues for a paradigm shift back to dividend investing. He criticizes modern portfolio theory's overemphasis on share price appreciation and extreme diversification, advocating for a business-owner's perspective grounded in tangible cash flows. Peris attributes the past decline in dividends to falling interest rates, the rise of buybacks, Silicon Valley's growth, and global sociopolitical shifts, and believes a return to more normal interest rates will renew focus on cash payouts.

title: CCEP GB launches PMPs for Jack Daniel’s and Coca-Cola ARTD range
summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners Great Britain (CCEP GB) has introduced price-marked packs (PMPs) for its Jack Daniel’s and Coca-Cola alcohol ready-to-drink (ARTD) range to offer clear value to customers and boost sales in convenience stores. The 330ml cans, priced at £2.39, include Jack Daniel’s and Coca-Cola Original Taste and Zero Sugar variants, which CCEP GB considers essential stock for retailers. This initiative is supported by POS materials and forms part of a broader promotional campaign with consumer giveaways and retailer incentives.

title: Coca-Cola® Zero Sugar Kicks Off Fan-Focused Fall Sports Campaign with Exclusive Partnership with EA SPORTS™ College Football 25
summary: Coca-Cola Zero Sugar is launching a fall sports campaign, partnering with EA SPORTS™ College Football 25 as its exclusive CPG sponsor. The campaign includes in-game rewards like College Ultimate Team™ packs for scanning Coke Zero Sugar, a "Fan Work is Thirsty Work Tour" visiting college campuses, and opportunities to win merchandise and trips. This initiative extends the "Best Coke Ever?" platform, aiming to connect with sports fans through refreshing taste and engaging experiences.

title: Ball Corporation collaborates with global beverage brands to champion sustainable aluminium packaging
summary: Ball Corporation is partnering with major beverage brands like Coca-Cola and PepsiCo to advance sustainability in aluminum packaging. This collaboration aims to meet the rising demand for aluminum, driven by its recyclability and lower carbon footprint, while addressing the challenge of enhancing recyclability for mixed aluminum packaging. The company's initiatives include developing lightweight designs, boosting recycled content, and incorporating renewable energy to achieve decarbonization within the aluminum industry.

title: Coca-Cola Andina y Coca-Cola Embonor, inauguran planta que permitirá producir las primeras botellas de bebida con plástico reciclado en Chile
summary: Coca-Cola Andina and Coca-Cola Embonor have inaugurated Re-Ciclar, a state-of-the-art recycling plant in Chile, which will produce the country's first beverage bottles made with food-grade recycled plastic. This $35 million investment aims to reduce new plastic circulation and strengthen the circular economy, with a capacity to recycle over 350 million bottles annually. Starting in 2025, 15% of all Coca-Cola bottles in Chile will contain recycled PET resin, with plans for gradual increases towards 100% recycled packaging.

title: Swire Coca-Cola to Build 570,000 SF Bottling Plant Near Denver International Airport Campus
