summary: Coca-Cola and its bottling partners in Argentina announced a $1.4 billion investment in the country until 2028, focusing on modernizing equipment, improving distribution centers, and renewing logistics fleets. This investment, confirmed during a meeting between Coca-Cola's president and CFO John Murphy and Argentinian President Javier Milei, also aims to enhance operational efficiency through digital solutions and strengthen sustainability initiatives. The plan reinforces Coca-Cola's commitment to Argentina's economic development, job creation, and local industry.

title: SPONSORED How Coca-Cola Consolidated is driving sustainability in Charlotte
summary: Coca-Cola Consolidated is advancing sustainability efforts in Charlotte through its "Refresh. Recycle. Renew." initiative, focusing on increasing recycling infrastructure and promoting a circular economy. The company partners with major venues like Spectrum Center, Bank of America Stadium, and Charlotte Motor Speedway to enhance recycling access and has transitioned to more sustainable packaging, including 100% recycled plastic bottles and lighter materials. Additionally, Coca-Cola Consolidated supports local environmental projects, such as tree planting with TreesCharlotte.

title: Annual Report 2024
summary: WPP has released its Annual Report for 2024, highlighting significant progress against its strategy despite a challenging environment. The report details the company's financial performance, including revenue and profitability, and showcases impactful campaigns for major brands. WPP also made strides in non-financial indicators like increasing women in executive leadership and expanding WPP Open monthly active users.

title: Heineken taps WPP’s AI muscle to strengthen below-the-line marketing
summary: Heineken has appointed WPP as its global agency partner for shopper marketing and commerce, specifically for below-the-line activities. This expanded relationship will heavily utilize WPP Open, the ad-holding group's AI-powered operating system, to enhance in-bar, retail, e-commerce, and sponsorship integrations for Heineken's various brands. The move aims to drive higher efficiencies in marketing during a dynamic period for the beer industry, despite recent setbacks for WPP, such as losing the Coca-Cola account.

title: OMAH ETF Holdings List — AMEX:OMAH
summary: This article provides a detailed list of the holdings for the OMAH ETF (VistaShares Target 15 Berkshire Select Income ETF) as of February 26, 2026. It includes company symbols, weight percentages, share counts, and market values for its top holdings such as Apple, Berkshire Hathaway, and American Express. The content highlights the fund's composition and offers deeper insights into its constituent stocks.

title: XLP ETF Holdings List — AMEX:XLP
summary: This article provides the XLP ETF Holdings List for the State Street Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR ETF as of February 27, 2026. It details the top holdings including Walmart, Costco, Procter & Gamble, Coca-Cola, and Philip Morris International, along with their respective weight percentages, shares, and market values. The data offers an overview of the ETF's composition in the consumer staples sector.

title: CELH Makes Big Move With Alani Nu: Time to Buy the Stock?
summary: Celsius Holdings (CELH) has acquired Alani Nutrition LLC (Alani Nu) for $1.8 billion, a strategic move to expand its presence in the functional, health-conscious beverage market and strengthen its position against competitors. This acquisition aims to leverage Alani Nu's loyal customer base, enhance Celsius's top-line growth and profitability, and capitalize on the growing demand for wellness-focused beverages. Despite impressive stock performance and growth prospects, challenges like rising operational costs, intense competition, and a high valuation have led analysts to issue a "Hold" rating for CELH stock.

title: Beverage Industry: Tariffs Affect Imports and Packaging, but Policy Durability Uncertain
summary: This article analyzes the potential impact of recent US tariff announcements on the beverage industry, focusing on companies like Brown-Forman and Constellation Brands. While tariffs could pressure sales and margins, the author believes they might be rescinded as a negotiating tactic, maintaining fair value estimates. The article also highlights the exposure of certain companies to tariffs on Mexican beers and EU imports, and the potential for increased packaging material costs due to tariffs on Chinese aluminum.

title: Coachella’s Hottest Tickets! Weekend One Parties
summary: This article lists the hottest parties taking place during Weekend One of Coachella 2025. It details various celebrity-hosted and brand-sponsored events, including MAXIM's "Welcome to Palm Springs" and Kendall Jenner's 818 Outpost, along with their dates, locations, featured performers, and brand partners. The guide provides all the essential information for attendees looking for exclusive festival experiences.

title: Potatoes, discount chains and drugmakers offer havens in stock-market bloodbath
summary: In a historic market selloff where the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell significantly, certain stocks provided havens for investors. Companies like Lamb Weston, Verizon Communications, and TJX Cos. bucked the trend, as Wall Street turned to businesses in tariff-resistant sectors such as food, prescription drugs, and subscription services, along with discount retailers. These companies offered relative stability amidst a broad decline across the S&P 500 and Nasdaq.

title: Canned Alcoholic Beverages Market Trends 2025-2035
summary: The canned alcoholic beverages market is projected to grow from USD 32.62 billion in 2025 to USD 55.72 billion by 2035, at a CAGR of 5.5%, driven by consumer demand for convenience, portability, and innovative flavors, especially in RTD cocktails and craft beers. Key growth factors include technological advancements in packaging, a shift towards health-conscious and sustainable options, and the expansion of distribution channels like on-trade establishments and e-commerce. China is expected to exhibit the fastest growth at 12.1% CAGR, while major players like Anheuser-Busch InBev and Diageo lead with diverse product offerings and strategic focus on sustainability and premiumization.

title: Costco makes some big changes to its food courts: here's the list
summary: Costco is implementing several changes to its food court offerings, despite the iconic $1.50 hot dog and soda combo remaining constant. These updates include the introduction of a new strawberry banana smoothie, the reintroduction of the turkey provolone sandwich, and a planned switch from Pepsi to Coca-Cola products. The company emphasizes that its food courts, along with other ancillary businesses, play a crucial role in encouraging repeat visits from its large membership base.

title: Campbell’s names new technology officer
summary: The Campbell’s Co. has appointed Aaron Gwinner as senior vice president and chief digital and technology officer, effective April 14. Gwinner will be responsible for leading the company’s digital transformation strategy, leveraging innovative technologies, and enhancing agility. He brings extensive experience from Reynolds American and The Coca-Cola Co., where he drove digital transformation and accelerated consumer engagement.

title: Soup and snack giant The Campbell’s Company hires tech veteran Aaron Gwinner for digital transforma
summary: The Campbell's Company has appointed Aaron Gwinner as Senior Vice President and Chief Digital & Technology Officer to spearhead its digital transformation strategy. Gwinner brings 30 years of experience from Reynolds American and The Coca-Cola Company, aiming to enhance agility, strengthen capabilities, and accelerate growth at Campbell's. His role will involve leveraging innovative technologies and collaborative leadership to improve operational efficiency and performance.

title: Shareholder advocacy targets flexible packaging, reusables and recycling labels
summary: Shareholder advocacy groups are intensifying their focus on packaging practices, targeting major companies like Coca-Cola, Starbucks, PepsiCo, and Kraft Heinz with proposals concerning flexible packaging, reusable options, and accurate recycling labels. These groups, including As You Sow and Green Century Funds, are pressing for greater transparency, accountability, and concrete action from corporations on plastic reduction, particularly given past missed targets. While some companies have reached agreements to disclose more information or phase out certain labels, others continue to resist, citing existing initiatives or the technical challenges of recycling specific materials.

title: Growth Strategy
summary: The Coca-Cola Company (KO) outlines its growth strategy focused on driving balanced growth across its total beverage portfolio. This strategy leverages the company's global scale and local market intimacy to capitalize on significant opportunities in both developed and emerging markets. Key pillars of this approach include advanced marketing, continuous innovation, strategic Revenue Growth Management, and integrated execution for optimal market presence and consumer engagement.

title: Procter & Gamble was the target of EU antitrust probe alongside Coca-Cola bottlers, Bloomberg reports
summary: Procter & Gamble (PG.N) is reportedly under investigation by EU antitrust regulators, alongside Coca-Cola bottlers, for potential restrictions on trade and market carving. The probe, initiated last month, involves inspections and questionnaires, but no formal allegations have been made against P&G yet. Companies found guilty of breaching EU antitrust rules face fines of up to 10% of their global annual revenues.

title: Bottling up sustainability, with Esther Moberly
summary: This article features an interview with Esther Moberly, Coca-Cola Consolidated's first sustainability manager, about the company's environmental initiatives. She discusses the importance of sustainability in corporate operations, specific programs in Charlotte like package recovery and water stewardship, and partnerships with local venues. The conversation also covers educational efforts regarding recycling and advice for reducing carbon emissions.

title: Coca-Cola under fire after explosive book reveals company's secrets: 'Selling sugar water'
summary: A new book titled "Sweet and Deadly" by Murray Carpenter exposes Coca-Cola's alleged history of funding organizations to mislead the public about the health impacts of its products. The book details how Coca-Cola has promoted the idea that lack of exercise, rather than poor diet, is the primary cause of obesity, while also contributing to diabetes and environmental issues. The article emphasizes the importance of highlighting these practices given Coca-Cola's substantial influence and its perceived positive public image despite these claims.

title: Sparkling Coconut Water Market To Expand at 19.5% CAGR by 2034
summary: The global Sparkling Coconut Water Market is forecasted to reach USD 13.7 billion by 2034, growing at a robust 19.5% CAGR from USD 2.3 billion in 2024. This significant expansion is driven by increasing consumer demand for healthier, natural, and functional beverages, with a focus on hydration, electrolytes, and low-calorie options. Key drivers include rising health awareness, innovative flavors, eco-friendly packaging, and expanding distribution channels, particularly in North America and Europe, while Asia-Pacific shows high growth potential.

title: Introducing Sprite Squad: Connecting Fans With Exclusive Partner Experiences, Giveaways and More
summary: Coca-Cola has launched Sprite Squad, a digital platform to connect fans with exclusive branded content, giveaways, and partner perks related to music, sports, and fashion. Consumers can access Sprite Squad by texting "THIRST" to 2653* and scanning a Sprite product, with new content and giveaways refreshing monthly. Initial partnerships include Sprite Chill and Black House Radio, with future collaborations planned throughout 2025 and into 2026.

title: 60 days to launch: Coca-Cola reaches millions with immersive campaign built on Azure
summary: Coca-Cola leveraged Microsoft Azure, particularly Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI Speech, to launch an immersive holiday campaign in just 60 days. This campaign featured a custom AI Santa model that conversed in real-time with over a million people in 26 languages, successfully enhancing emotional connections and brand loyalty across 43 markets. The initiative highlighted Azure's robust capabilities for scalability, multilingual support, and secure, AI-powered marketing campaigns.

title: Coca-Cola Andina invertirá US$ 500 millones entre 2025 y 2026
summary: Coca-Cola Andina announced an investment of over US$500 million between 2025 and 2026, primarily to expand its productive and logistics capacity in Brazil, including a new mineral water line and a multi-category line at its Duque de Caxias plant. This investment will make Andina the first Coca-Cola bottler to produce beer. The company's president, Gonzalo Said, also expressed concerns about Chile's weak economic growth and low productivity impacting competitiveness, job creation, and consumption.

title: Coca Cola Andina invertirá más de US$500 millones con foco expansivo en Brasil
summary: Coca Cola Andina announced an investment of over US$500 million for 2025-2026, primarily focused on expanding operations in Brazil. Key projects include a new mineral water production line and a multi-category plant in Duque de Caxias, which will make them the first Coca-Cola bottler to produce beer. While Brazil shows improved growth, concerns remain regarding economic conditions in Chile and Argentina.

title: Mitigating Tariffs: 3 Stocks to Gain From a Weaker U.S. Dollar
summary: This article identifies three stocks — Coca-Cola, Apple, and Caterpillar — that could benefit significantly from a weaker U.S. dollar, counteracting the effects of tariffs. A weaker dollar makes U.S. products cheaper for international buyers, potentially increasing demand and turning currency headwinds into tailwinds for companies with substantial overseas revenue. The author explains how companies often report "currency headwinds" but that a weaker dollar can lead to higher sales volumes abroad despite lower margins.

title: Calculating The Fair Value Of The Coca-Cola Company (NYSE:KO)
summary: This article uses a two-stage Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model to estimate the fair value of The Coca-Cola Company (NYSE:KO). It projects a fair value of US$88.65, suggesting that the current share price of US$71.68 is trading at similar levels to its fair value, with a 19% discount. The analysis emphasizes that while DCF is a useful tool, it has limitations and should not be the sole basis for investment decisions.

title: Tariffs become a new front line in the cola war between Coke and Pepsi
summary: The centuries-old rivalry between Coca-Cola and PepsiCo is being affected by new tariffs. PepsiCo, which produces much of its concentrate in Ireland, is facing a 10% tariff on imports to the U.S., while Coca-Cola largely avoids these tariffs by manufacturing in Atlanta and Puerto Rico. This situation creates a disadvantage for PepsiCo, especially as it recently fell to third place in soda sales behind Dr Pepper.

title: Powerade Unveils New Campaign Featuring Lamine Yamal and Rodrygo Goes to Celebrate the Power of Pause
summary: Powerade has launched a new global campaign called "Pause is Power," featuring young football stars Lamine Yamal and Rodrygo Goes. The campaign emphasizes the importance of an intentional pause for hydration, preparation, and focus to achieve peak athletic performance. It includes two films, "The 304" and "My First Love," which highlight the athletes' unique pre-game rituals and will support Powerade's presence at major sporting events through 2028.

title: Caroline Nadeau takes on GM role for Conagra Brands in Canada
summary: Caroline Nadeau has been appointed as the new general manager for Conagra Brands in Canada. She brings extensive experience from other major CPG companies like Coca-Cola and Campbell's Soup Company. In her new role, Nadeau will report to Paul Hogan and will be responsible for driving growth and innovation for the company in the Canadian market.

title: COCA COLA CAPITALISM
summary: This article criticizes Coca-Cola's global expansion tactics, particularly in Mexico, highlighting its historical use of addictive ingredients and aggressive marketing. It discusses the severe health consequences of high sugar consumption, such as type 2 diabetes and obesity, and Coca-Cola's role in Mexico's water crisis. The author, Bruce Hobson, also details the political and economic influence of Coca-Cola, including its ties to former Mexican President Vicente Fox.

title: SCHD Is Down, But Its Dividend Is Up And These 2 ETFs Are Quietly Catching Up
summary: The Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF (SCHD) offers predictability and income through consistent dividend raises, despite a recent price dip. Its high SEC 30-day yield of 4.01% and low 0.06% expense ratio make it attractive for long-term investors. Vanguard High Dividend Yield ETF (VYM) and iShares Select Dividend ETF (DVY) are also strong contenders for diversifying a dividend-focused portfolio.

title: ‘We’ve done 6,000 pitches this year’ – WPP dismisses new business concerns
summary: WPP CEO Mark Read addressed concerns about new business performance following a challenging first quarter with a 5% revenue decline to $4.2 million. He emphasized the large volume of "under-the-radar" pitches, estimating 6,000 to 7,000 this year, and highlighted the role of data and AI (specifically WPP Open) in improving pitch success rates by 10%. Despite some client losses, Read reiterated optimism for the second half of the year, noting that top clients are still growing and the absence of a major pullback in marketing spend due to economic uncertainty.

title: Coca-Cola: la embotelladora Reginald Lee inauguró una nueva línea de envases retornables con una inversión de USD 18,5 millones
summary: Reginald Lee, Coca-Cola's first bottler in Argentina, has invested USD 18.5 million in a new production line for returnable packaging at its plant in Ranelagh. This investment is part of a larger USD 1.4 billion plan by the Coca-Cola System and aims to increase the production of 2-liter RefPET and 1-liter glass returnable bottles, enhance efficiency, and promote sustainability. The initiative reinforces the company's commitment to the Argentine market and offers consumers more affordable and environmentally friendly options.

title: Coca-Cola Sales Dented by Hispanic Boycott, Lower Demand
summary: Coca-Cola reported a net income of $3.33 billion for the first quarter, despite a 3% volume drop in North America due to a decline in carbonated soft-drink sales. The company attributed some of its sales challenges to a Hispanic boycott and lower demand, impacting sales in the U.S. and Latin American markets such as Mexico and Chile. The CEO stated that while social-media misinformation affected results, the company believes it can manage the effects of tariffs.

title: Coke keeps full-year forecast, says it expects tariff disruptions to be 'manageable' after Pepsi cuts earnings outlook
summary: Coca-Cola (KO) reported first-quarter earnings and revenue that exceeded Wall Street estimates and reaffirmed its full-year forecast. The beverage giant expects global trade conflicts and potential cost increases for materials like aluminum to be "manageable," distinguishing itself from rival PepsiCo, which trimmed its earnings outlook due to tariffs. Coca-Cola's unit case volume grew 2%, driven by strong performance in India, China, and Brazil, despite some market challenges and negative consumer sentiment in North America.
